A long-established barber shop in the Old Quarter frequented by the fashionable, well-groomed citizens of Saint Denis. You can get your hair and facial hair restyled here.
A loose fit with an asymmetric front and frilled collar makes this shirtwaist a superior choice for sophisticated women. Order today to avoid disappointment.
A lush and fertile region of Lemoyne, featuring Flat Iron Lake to the west and home to the historic town of Rhodes.
A lush region in northern New Hanover known for its forests, dramatic rock formations, and sharp cliff drops.
A man gave a rib away - to create something, a mate, a companion, and one that inevitably betrayed him. I am here to witness through teachings that money will never blind or betray you. And it can be used in exchange for whatever you want. This path to wealth does not require you to remove a rib, watch your sons kill one another (unless you require it for amusement), and or be deprived in wanton desperation in such a way that you must interbreed to make a family.
A man has set up a herbalist camp in the wilderness. He would like some help with collecting herbs.
A man's fine satin embroidered Puff Tie available in various colors with a bronze tie pin. These ties gratify the tastes of the neatest dresser.
A member of the pike family, pickerel are energetic fighters and a tasty, flaky fish. Voracious feeders, they favor cornmeal bait.
A military favorite, the Lancaster Springfield is a powerful breech-loading weapon designed for medium to long-range combat. The high accuracy makes this weapon effective against large mammals, but the slow firing rate may be an issue when trapped in close quarters. This gun is a single-shot weapon, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive rifle ammo.
A mining town established by German settlers who discovered the rich coal seams in the surrounding hills. The surrounding countryside and waterways are sooty and polluted from the mining operations which have been running for almost a century.
A mining town in Roanoke Ridge that has been providing coal up and down the Lannahechee River for almost a century.
A mix of only the finest fox and coyote pelts make up this pair of chaps. Completed with sturdy leather bands and woven rope, these will keep any traveler warm.
A modest General Store is tucked away in this railway station serving the mountainous Cumberland Falls region. You can buy goods and order from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue. There's also a Post Office in the same building.
A modest but well-traveled settlement, off the road in eastern Tall Trees, home to a community of Norwegian immigrants.
A modest general store is tucked away in this railway station serving the mountainous Cumberland Falls region. You can buy and sell goods, and order from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue. There's also a post office in the same building.
A most anticipated addition, this poncho is handwoven in Chuparosa and shipped to our warehouse. Throw over the shoulder for a debonair look.
A most fetching design featuring ornate steel toe caps. Available in a variety of skins and furs for statement vamp and shaft combinations.
A most opulent design, available in a range of reptile skins and boasting fur lapels and pocket flaps. Truly superb craftmanship.
A mostly forested region of West Elizabeth, home to many different types of wildlife including bears, elk and wolves.
A mostly mountainous state, sparsely inhabited because of its harsh winters and rugged terrain.
A much-loved design. Paneling around the inner thigh provides a reinforced seat for additional comfort while riding.
A must-have for every angler. Fish in a wide array of environments find this Special Spinner completely irresistible.
A neat addition to our ladies' line, this blouse features a lace up front, ruched trim, and neat satin bow detail. Comfortable and modern.
A neat and tidy store that's well stocked with a variety of firearms and ammunition. There's a guest room in back, available to rent by the night, and you can even take a bath here.
A neat and tidy store that's well stocked with a variety of firearms, bows, and ammunition.
A neighborhood cello teacher, JONES repeatedly STABBED a student to his DEATH with her bow. JUSTICE wanted for this SAVAGE crime.
A new Competitive Challenge is starting. When the lobby timer runs down a free-for-all will begin where players compete in specific skills like riding or shooting. Get the highest score among all the players in the session to win.
A new import from Germany, the Muhlberg Mauser is a modern semi-automatic pistol with low damage. The rapid fire rate of this weapon, along with a large ammo capacity, make this a good choice for close range combat, or when surrounded by multiple enemies. This gun has an ammo capacity of ten rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive pistol ammo.
A new philanthropic organization working for the amelioration of the condition of the poorWon't you help our efforts with a small donation? Pauperism is on the rise through every state in this great land.We are fundraising today to help finance the first rescue mission in the county, we aim to:1. Help those begging and soliciting victuals to be provided of food, clothing, and a clean bed to sleep in.
A new piece in our popular Drifter style, made from thick and hardy beaver pelt, hand treated for durability. Its wide reinforced band and sturdy brim can endure the stormiest conditions.
A newer version of Social Club is required. The updater may have failed. Please exit the game and install the latest version of Social Club. Installed version: . Press OK to view Rockstar Games Customer Support to help resolve this issue. Press CANCEL to exit.
A no-lapel Traditional Vest with flat hem featuring a slanted two pocket front and satin back. Made from heavy weight union cassimere. You will find no higher quality anywhere.
A no-nonsense drinking establishment, favored by citizens of the older and less affluent neighborhoods in Saint Denis. You can drink beer and whiskey here.
A notorious brawler and scoundrel, HARPER is wanted for the PUBLIC KILLING of Miss Ethel Pickering in a fit of DRUNKEN RAGE.
A once bustling New Austin town that has been on a steady decline ever since they built the railroad to nearby Armadillo.
A once bustling New Austin town that has been on the decline ever since they built the railroad to nearby Armadillo, Tumbleweed is dominated by the overbearing and draconian Sheriff Freeman who dispenses frontier justice very forcefully.
A paleontologist, Deborah MacGuiness, asks for help with finding dinosaur bones for her latest discovery, the "Totalisaurus".
A party is starting. Head into camp to join the celebrations. Leave the area to miss the party.
A peculiar business operating out of a colorful trailer just outside the town of Rhodes, the shopkeeper here is a craftsman with an interest in unusual artefacts.
A peculiar business operating out of a colorful trailer just outside the town of Rhodes, the shopkeeper here is a craftsman with an interest in unusual artifacts.
A perfectly modern pair, featuring pull straps with a scalloped dip and neat piping around the welt and counter. Exquisite.
A perfectly structured wide-brimmed hat with a folded leather band. Perfect for shielding your face from sun and strangers.
A photograph taken by Albert Mason showing a pack of wolves before they tried to eat him.
A player has been downed. You can revive  with ~INPUT_CONTEXT_Y~ if you reach them before their health empties.
A player has been downed. You have to drop whatever you're carrying if you want to revive .
A popular and classic sidearm, the Buck Cattleman is a great all-around revolver, featuring a good balance of damage, accuracy and fire rate. Suited for close to medium-range combat, this weapon can also be dual wielded and used on horseback. This gun has an ammo capacity of six rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive revolver ammo.
A popular and sensible design of thick cut leather. No better pair exists for this price.
A popular breed of dog that can be found in towns across the states. Their intelligence and their gentle temperament make them excellent companions.
A popular breed that can be found in towns across the states. These dogs were bred for hunting, and is a cousin of the English Foxhound.
A popular breed with strong sense of smell makes them excellent hunting dogs, especially for tracking raccoons.
A popular design among those working out of doors, these rough stitched fingerless gloves with fur cuffs are warm and practical.
A powerful explosive, designed for mining and construction purposes. It can be used to clear out groups of enemies, or effectively blow up a variety of things including mines, trains and safes. Light and throw towards your target, or place it down before igniting and running to a safe distance. It cannot be purchased from Gunsmith stores, but some less-than-reputable sellers may stock this item.
A prim and proper Southern town on the surface, but many residents can't forget the Civil War nor the town's pre-war glory days, when the horrific oppression of the slave trade made white landowners rich. Racial tensions, corruption, and old family feuds run deep.
A prim and proper southern town on the surface, racial tensions, corruption, and old feuds still run deep in Rhodes.
A rare Cattleman Revolver, featuring delicate engravings and a carved ivory handle. Previously owned by the late gunslinger Flaco Hernandez, defeated in a duel at Cairn Lake, this gun has an ammo capacity of six rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive revolver ammo.
A rare Cattleman Revolver, with a dark metal finish and covered in custom engravings. Previously owned by the late gunslinger Emmet Granger, defeated in a duel near Flatneck Station, this gun has an ammo capacity of six rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive revolver ammo.
A rare Double-Action Revolver featuring a compact shortened barrel, gold-inlay decorative engraving work, and a unique hand-carved pearl grip. This previously belonged to Algernon Wasp, a collector of exotic items in Saint Denis. This gun has an ammo capacity of six rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive revolver ammo.
A rare Double-Barreled Shotgun with faded brass tarnish and adorned with carvings. Previously owned and cherished by a lonely woodsman living in solitude amongst the trees and wildlife of Roanoke Ridge. This gun has an ammo capacity of two rounds, and can use Regular Buckshot, Incendiary Buckshot, Slug and Explosive Slug shotgun ammo.
A rare Hatchet, featuring a double-bladed head: one razor-sharp side for chopping and cutting; and a dull side for splitting wood. This melee weapon was found in a tree stump near Wallace Station in Big Valley, and appears to be fairly new. This Hatchet can also be thrown.
A rare Hatchet, featuring a rusted double-bladed head: one razor-sharp side for chopping and cutting; and a dull side for splitting wood. This melee weapon was found in a tree stump near Annesburg Mine in Roanoke Ridge, and has been worn by the elements over time. This Hatchet can also be thrown.
A rare Hatchet, with a long bearded axe bit that allows for greater control when planing or shaving wood. The melee weapon was found in a tree stump near Three Sisters in the Grizzlies, and has been worn by the elements over time. This Hatchet can also be thrown.
A rare Hatchet, with a long bearded axe bit that allows for greater control when planing or shaving wood. The melee weapon was found in a tree stump near Window Rock in the Grizzlies, and appears to be fairly new. This Hatchet can also be thrown.
A rare Mauser Pistol, this weapon features gold-plated engravings and a black wooden grip. Previously owned by the late gunslinger Billy Midnight, defeated in a duel on a train departing Rhodes, this gun has an ammo capacity of ten rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive pistol ammo.
A rare Rolling Block Rifle made of light wood and blackened steel, adorned with carvings. Previously belonging to a bounty hunter after Josiah Trelawny, and found in a barn near Braithwaite Manor, this gun is a single-shot weapon, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive rifle ammo.
A rare Schofield Revolver made of gold and ivory, and adorned with custom engravings. Found inside a cave in Cholla Springs, this weapon appears to have once been owned by the famed gunslinger Otis Miller. This gun has an ammo capacity of six rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive revolver ammo.
A rare Schofield Revolver plated in silver, with "Canis Canem Edit" engraved down the side of the barrel. Previously belonging to the late gunslinger Jim 'Boy' Calloway, who was shot in the back by the coward Slim Grant, this gun has an ammo capacity of six rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive revolver ammo.
A rare ancient Hatchet, engraved all over with Nordic patterns and bound with leather. This melee weapon was found at an old stone altar in the Roanoke Valley area of New Hanover, lodged into a skull. This Hatchet can also be thrown.
A rare blue speckled egg. These can be found in hawk nests in trees, on the peaks of mountains and on high hilltops.
A rare crafted knife, made with a large piece of flint as a blade, and the jawbone of a coyote as a handle. A reward for collecting dinosaur bones for Deborah MacGuiness, an amateur paleontologist located in Firwood Rise, Cumberland Forest.
A rare dappled egg. These can be found in vulture nests constructed in the natural hollows of large trees.
A rare decorative dagger, featuring a silver blade embossed with ornate designs and a gold statuette handle. This weapon previously belonged to a strange pale man dressed in black, discovered lurking amongst the back alleyways of Saint Denis.
A rare hunting knife, with a wide clip-point blade and worn curved wooden handle. This knife was found sticking out of the back of a corpse deep in the mines of Beryl's Dream, Big Valley. The previous owner of this weapon went to great lengths to prevent their crime from being discovered.
A rare knife, with a handle manufactured from the antler of a stag, and part of the blade snapped off near the crossguard. This weapon was taken from the scene of a fight between a large bear and a hunter, which occurred near Hanging Dog Ranch in Big Valley. Neither side won.
A rare white egg. These can be found in eagle nests on the tops of hills and mountains, or in the branches of trees.
A recent addition to our catalogue, made from our popular patented velvet corduroy, these fashionable pants are the handsomest on offer and more suited for culling than courting.
A recent outbreak of cholera has devastated this once-prosperous town, forcing many businesses to close their doors.
A recently-established cattle ranch in Big Valley, West Elizabeth, run by the Geddes family and easy prey for rustlers and gangs in the area.
A region lush with forests and teeming with wildlife, encompassing the town of Strawberry to the south.
A region of grassy wetlands in northeast Lemoyne, too soft and marshy for much in the way of human habitation.
A region of humid swamps and wetlands in Lemoyne, extending south to the busy port city of Saint Denis.
A region of open grassland and rolling hills where buffalo, deer and wild horses roam, home to the town of Blackwater.
A region of open plains and mesas where vegetation becomes scrubbier toward the desert flats that lie to the west.
A relaxed sweater of knitted wool with tasteful roll neck, patterned stitched front, and thick ribbed cuffs and collar. We highly recommend this item.
A reliable and popular repeating rifle, the Buck Carbine provides medium damage and a decent firing rate, with quick reload speeds thanks to the tube-loaded magazine in the weapon's stock. A good, balanced choice for hunting and medium-range combat, this gun has an ammo capacity of seven rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive repeater ammo.
A remote cave in the hills of Roanoke Ridge previously occupied by a feral gang called the Murfree Brood. Many people have disappeared without trace in this area and everybody stays well away from it these days.
A reservation up in a remote, inhospitable area of the Grizzlies, now 'home' to the remnants of a Native American tribe.
A resilient climbing vine with purple flowers in scented pendants, Wisteria prefers well-drained soil and can often be found in woodlands.
A reward of TWENTY FIVE DOLLARS will be paid for the arrest of ELLIE ANNE SWAN wanted for the crime of MATRICIDE. THE ABOVE AMOUNT WILL BE PAID IMMEDIATELY FOR THE DELIVERY OF THE PRISONER.WANTED ALIVE FOR QUESTIONING.
A rival has started a mission. Defend the target  or attack the rival to compete against them.
A rival has started a mission. Eliminate the target  or attack the rival to compete against them.
A rival has started a mission. Gain control of the target  or attack the rival to compete against them.
A rough, raucous town that provides livestock at auction to Heartlands landowners and refreshment to thirsty cowboys.
A rough, raucous, hard-working town that provides livestock at auction to Heartlands landowners, and rest and refreshment to thirsty cowboys. It's nicknamed "Mudtown" because the streets, buildings, and most of the residents are rarely clean.
A rugged hairstyle especially suited to Traders and aspiring musicians, paired with a fashionable two-pronged beard.
A ruined building deep in the jungle on the island of Guarma in the Spanish West Indies overlooking a sugar plantation run by local despot, Alberto Fussar.
A rustic design with a slightly tilted crown, flop brim and thin leather band. Ideal country wear.
A secluded plateau in the Heartlands region of New Hanover, overlooking a horseshoe-shaped bend in the Dakota River.
A self-styled BAND OF DISSIDENTS, these men are WANTED DEAD OR ALIVE for the MURDER of Mayor Bowman and a number of city councilmen.
A sharp single breasted number of cotton and linen with notched lapel and clean cut. All our sizes are made to measure each and every individual client, provided their measurements match our ready-to-wear sizes.
A shirt of worsted wool with four large buttons. For those who want the smartness of a shirt with the warmth of a sweater. Fully warrantied.
A short-collared shirt made from a comfortable cotton canvas blend with matching suspenders.
A shrub formed of sharp, pointed leaves and clusters of yellow flowers, Agarita prefers dry soil and rocky slopes and produces sweet red berries.
A simple and classic cut poncho, the Cardenas is comfortable and versatile. A popular piece.
A simple but classic design from Stenger, with sturdy wrapped leather, hammered brass studs and 8 point rowels.
A simple inn situated on the waterfront at Van Horn. Rooms and baths are available here.
A simple saloon where thirsty travelers can get out of the heat. You can drink beer and whiskey here.
A simple sketched map showing a landmark and other clues to a possible treasure in Annesburg.
A single breasted coat of cotton and linen mix, sporting a notched lapel and practical pockets. Medium weight fabric with rounded tails, this newly imported English design is hardy but dignified.
A skilled gunsmith operates this well-stocked store in Saint Denis' Chinatown. You can purchase all kinds of weapons, ammunition, and hunting accessories here.
A skilled gunsmith operates this well-stocked store in Saint Denis's Chinatown. You can buy and sell all kinds of weapons, ammunition, and hunting accessories.
A small Post Office is tucked into the back of the Wallace Station General Store. Here you may receive your mail.
A small knife with a straight blade, designed and balanced so it can be thrown with ease. Can be used to silently take down enemies at range, or used as a melee weapon if required. It can be purchased from some less-than-reputable sellers, or save a trip by recollecting the knife after throwing.
A small logging town undergoing a cultural transformation at the bidding of its new mayor, an East Coast eccentric.
A small, remote settlement out in the swamps of Bayou Nwa, the people here live self-sufficiently for the most part.
A smart addition to our line of pants, featuring hand-cut leather paneling and cross stitched sides. Perfect for town or trail.
A smart button-topped cap, available in a variety of colors with a thin leather band. Worn by our most stylish working-class clientele.
A smuggler of DANGEROUS CONTRABAND, originally from RHODES, KELLY SHOT a police officer while RESISTING ARREST in Saint Denis. Now fugitive and at large.
A soft, high-waisted, leather wrap skirt with long fringing and cross stitching. An original design.
A sole trader keeps Van Horn and the Roanoke Ridge area supplied with provisions, hunting and fishing supplies, and sundries all stocked in this warehouse on the pier. You can sell any items you don't need and use the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue here too.
A sole trader operates a trading post on the wharf. A selection of weapons and provisions can be purchased here, and the shopkeeper can also craft some more unusual items.
A spacious General Store, located near the docks in Saint Denis. It's well stocked with fresh provisions and luxury goods like tobacco and coffee. You can make purchases from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue.
A spacious general store, located near the docks in Saint Denis. It's well stocked with fresh provisions and luxury goods like tobacco and coffee. The Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue is available and you can sell your items here too.
A stable supplying horses, horse storage, grooming and customization services to the Roanoke Ridge region.
A stable supplying the New Austin region with horses, horse storage, grooming and customization.
A stallholder in the Saint Denis market who takes a particular interest in wild animal pelts, the Trapper can create crafted items to order if you bring him the parts. You can also buy some hunting supplies here.
A state-of-the-art shovel specially designed for archaeological digs. An essential tool for uncovering buried Collectibles.
A strange professor needs help acquiring 100 gallons of moonshine for a machine he's building.
A stranger ~BLIP_AMBIENT_PED_MEDIUM~ is requesting help. Approach them and hold ~INPUT_INTERACT_LOCKON~ when prompted to speak to the stranger.
A stray Catahoula Cur who wandered his way into camp at Clemens Point. Named by Dutch, Cain loves attention and has found a new family within the gang.
A street kid steals Sister Calderon's crucifix. Arthur chases the kid through the streets of Saint Denis to get it back.
A striking boot with a narrow pointed toe, medium curved heel, and combined lace and buckle fastenings. Manufactured especially for customers of our house.
A striking design with a flopped brim and leather band, featuring a fan of cardinal feathers secured with a semi-precious stone.
A striking evergreen plant with cymes of vibrant orange-red flowers, the Blood Flower thrives in swampy ground.
A strong pinched crown hat with a stylishly adorned buckled band. Guaranteed weatherproof. One of our top sellers this season.
A studio equipped with all the latest in professional photographic technology. The photographer will take your portrait against your choice of scenic backdrops, solo or posing with your sweetheart or Posse, for a lasting memento of your visit to Blackwater.
A studio equipped with all the latest in professional photographic technology. The photographer will take your portrait against your choice of scenic backdrops, solo or posing with your sweetheart or posse, for a lasting memento of your visit to Blackwater.
A stunning two-tone design, this coat features soft tiered top grain leather and fancy brass buttons.
A stylish Paisley Vest with a shawl collar and two straight pockets. Available in a selection of hand embroidered patterns. Makes a pleasing contrast with any outfit.
A stylish shirt complete with wrapped silk neckerchief pinned in place by an amethyst brooch.
A test of nerve in which players must complete a sequence of knife stabs between the fingers of an outstretched hand. In Classic mode, you get five lives.
A test of nerve in which players must complete a sequence of knife stabs between the fingers of an outstretched hand. In this Burnout variation, you get only one life and 30 seconds to complete as many rounds as you can.
A test of nerve in which players must complete a sequence of knife stabs between the fingers of an outstretched hand. In this Guts variation, you get unlimited lives, but must aim to complete perfect rounds in a 20 second time limit.
A thin band of cotton canvas to accentuate the neck and accessorize the collar. The very best for the price.
A tin full of live crickets. Excellent for attracting medium-sized river fish, especially smallmouth bass.
A tin full of live worms. Excellent for attracting medium-sized lake fish, especially steelhead trout.
A top quality, serviceable outfit with a military finish. Ideal in hot temperatures and favored by New Austin residents.
A tough boot of thick leather with a round toe and high cut backs. Our patented worker heel is hammered with double the amount of pins to ensure a long life.
A tough perennial with large leaves and vibrant red stalks, Rhubarb prefers to grow in open, sunny ground.
A traditional native Tomahawk with a striped bound shaft and polished sharp blade. Although showing some signs of its age, this weapon has been well maintained by one of the locals. This melee weapon was found lodged in a broken wooden target, overlooking Calumet Ravine in the Grizzlies.
A traveling farrier, GARDENER was seen by multiple witnesses BLUDGEONING to DEATH first Mr. John Hepton, then Mr. Hepton's famous white Arabian horse, ACHILLES.
A tried and tested favorite, the Dillehay Hat's tall pinched crown and feather details are sure to catch the eye.
A true novelty, we present this fashionable shirtwaist with a fine lace bib front and neat standing collar with smart buttons.
A twist on a classic boot, with decorative pull tabs and hand tooled legs. Available in fashionable alligator and snakeskin.
A unique pair of spurs with 6 point rowels, tooled leather boot straps and bald eagle design.
A useful pair of specialized Binoculars through which dig sites glow from a great distance.
A variant of the Double-Action Revolver, the stylish High Roller Revolver from D. D. Packenbush is the perfect sidearm for the modern gunslinger. In a class of its own, the High Roller features ornate engravings and a pearl grip and is deadly when dual wielded. This gun has an ammo capacity of six rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive revolver ammo.
A vast region full of wildlife and fertile land has made this area popular with ranchers and farmers.
A vest of opulent style. Notched lapel, pointed hem and a satin trim. Comes in elegant patterns suitable for enjoying a pipe at a dinner party, rolling your eyes at ludicrous attendees.
A vial-headed arrow that drains the target's stamina and creates a distinct trail in Eagle Eye. Vial bursts on impact.
A visual variant of the Bolt Action Rifle suited for Bounty Hunters. Can be applied to any owned Bolt Action Rifle.
A visual variant of the Lancaster Repeater suited for Collectors. Can be applied to any owned Lancaster Repeater.
A visual variant of the Pump-Action Shotgun suited for Traders. Can be applied to any owned Pump-Action Shotgun.
A visual variant of the Schofield Revolver suited for Bounty Hunters. Can be applied to any owned Schofield Revolver.
A visual variant of the Volcanic Pistol suited for Collectors. Can be applied to any owned Volcanic Pistol.
A warrant has been issued for the apprehension and return of JIM LARSON, DEAD or ALIVE. WANTED for the theft of payroll and MURDER of his foreman, Anthony O'Day, who surprised him in the act.
A well-equipped General Store supplying a range of fresh and preserved foods, coffee, tobacco and household goods to the townsfolk of Rhodes. You can purchase items from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue here.
A well-equipped general store supplying a range of fresh and preserved foods, coffee, tobacco and household goods to the townsfolk of Rhodes. You can sell any unwanted items, and make purchases from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue here.
A well-known pistolier, BROOKS is wanted for KILLING one of his fellow drinkers at the saloon by PUSHING HIM down the stairs when he lost at poker.
A well-liked style. Beaver fur felt and striped satin head band with a flat top and slightly turned brim.
A while ago, I met an odd man dressed as a lady animal trainer. Are all Englishmen that weird I wonder? All his animals were as fake as the rest of his act. Until I was to find and retrieve a “real lion” from somewhere or other in Africa I thought was going to be another dog. But no - it was a real lion - thing looked like it wanted me for its next meal.
A wide-bladed axe with a short ridged wooden handle, this hunting and cooking tool is usually used to prepare animal carcasses and chop through thick meat, cartilage and bone. As you can imagine, these properties also make for an effective combat weapon, and it can also be thrown.
A wise man once told me the joy of gunslinging was that it is win-win: you get freedom or glory. Calloway can have the freedom, I'll take the glory, and you can have the satisfaction of knowing the truth behind a famous lie, or maybe Calloway has the glory and I have the freedom, I cannot quite decide. Either way, he's dead. Thank you, again, good Lord! And half of the proceeds of this nonsense's dissemination are yours.Yours truly,Theodore Levin
A witness that hasn't seen the criminal is marked with a dark red ~BLIP_AMBIENT_EYEWITNESS~. They'll report this evidence and law will come to investigate further.
A woman's work is never done, and long winters or harvest weeks can cause bad humor and melancholy. It is prized highly and regarded as a very necessity for housekeeping.
ABIGAIL RUTHERFORD, known to her friends as ABBY, is sought after for the VIOLENT ATTACK upon and MUTILATION of Col. Jerimiah Rutherford, steward of the HAGEN ORCHARDS, BAYOU NWA. Now fugitive.
ABSCONDED with his father-in-law's prized carriage and other valuables. TRAMPLED a farm hand in the process, CRIPPLING HIM.
ALL GARMENTS ARE GUARANTEED EXACTLY AS REPRESENTED. WE PRESENT TO YOU THE LEADING STYLE IN BOTH WORK AND LEISURE WEAR TODAY.
ALL OF WHICH GIVE A VERY RARE PERSONAL MAGNETISM THAT CAN ONLY BE ACQUIRED THROUGH CATALOGUE COMMERCE.

AN ANGLER IS A PROPHET, a muse, a man of instinct that profits by his higher intelligence and temperament. He is alpha, not a bottom feeder, and an ingenious modification to a lure can bring a beastly bottom feeder to be his breakfast.Monster Catfish and Gar love this lure. Pike and Salmon find it appealing as well. Best of luck!
AN ELEGANT ENSEMBLE FOR THE PASTORAL PROFESSIONAL, THIS OUTFIT WILL DELIGHT IN FORM AND FUNCTION.
ANA MARIA LOPEZ, also known as LA MADRE DEL INFIERNO, is on the run after DETONATING EXPLOSIVES inside three mine entrances outside of ANNESBURG. There were NO SURVIVORS.
ANGER, MISCHIEF, REVENGE, THEY SIMPLY DO NOT EXIST IN CHELONIA.America can rise to where it was always supposed to be. 100 years ago, our master foresaw it. He told all that would listen. For paradise provides, and we are at its teats. The teats of Chelonia await you. Do not refuse it lest you go hungry and your mother chides you. Remember these things, and tell everyone of the teats and the shells.
AT THE SECOND HOUR UNDER THE HALF MOONBY THE GREAT LOVE AND GRACE OF OUR SAVIOR KUHKOWABAVOYAGER OF TIME AND GALAXIESWE CAST OFF OUR CORPORAL SHELLSSO HIS VESSEL CAN TAKE OUR SPIRITS TO THE PROMISED REALMTO LIVE IN PEACE AND POWER UNTIL THE TWO THOUSANDTH YEARWHEN WE WILL RETURN FOR THE NEW CHOSENAND WORSHIP ONCE AGAIN AT THE PEAK OF MOUNT SHANNIN HIS LOVE WE REJOICE ALWAYS
AVOID ANY PHYSICAL CONTACT or social intercourse with others.REMOVE ALL solid food from the diet in favor of rennet whey or rice-water.ABSTAIN FROM dark liquors unless habit has rendered them indispensable.PLACE TWO DROPS of ammonia on the tongue at both dawn and dusk.THE DEAD SHOULD BE DISPOSED OF quickly and unceremoniously, preferably burned.RESIDENTS who are able to LEAVE THE AREA are ADVISED TO DO SO.By Order of SECRETARY OF THE BOARDH. Jackson-Clark
Abigail and Jack came back. Whole of my life suddenly makes some kind of sense.If only I could pay off these damn debts -- and if only I could have been a different man all these years I wasted being a fool.
Abigail has noticed the stuffed squirrel John placed on the mantel piece in Beecher's Hope.

Activating Dead Eye Level 3 will allow you to remain in Dead Eye after firing your weapon.
Activating Dead Eye Level 5 will highlight critical areas in addition to fatal areas while in Dead Eye.
Activating The Increase Horse Bonding cheat will increase your bonding with all your owned Horses.
Activating the Clear All Bounties And Lockdown Areas cheat will remove all Bounties and Lockdown areas.
Activating the Fortify Health, Stamina and Dead Eye Bars cheat will refill and Fortify all of your bars.
Activating the Gunslinger Weapons cheat will grant access to a loadout of Gunslinger Weapons.
Activating the Increase Health, Stamina and Dead Eye Bar Levels cheat will increase the level of all your bars.

Additional lawmen are patrolling while a town is locked down and you will become wanted again if spotted before clearing your bounty.
Adjust the luminance until you can see detail in both the dark and light areas.Suggested brightness for OLED TV is 300, for LCD 100.
Adjustable cooking spit and griddle. For camp or hearth. Allows for cooking meats to perfection.
Adjusts image sharpening intensity of Temporal Anti-Aliasing.This enables more control over the definition of objects when TAA is enabled, but can lead to over sharpening or smudging at high and low levels respectively.
Adjusts internal resolution by forcing the game to render at a certain level and then scale to your Resolution setting. This can improve image quality.Increasing this will not increase the resolution the game is displayed at.
Adjusts texture quality. This changes the level of detail observable on objects, buildings and the environment.
Adjusts the quality of ambient shadows where two surfaces meet.Full Resolution SSAO allows the shadows to be rendered at higher resolution when compared to standard SSAO, at the expense of extra GPU processing power.
Adjusts the quality of depth definition on selected surfaces.This gives ground and roof textures more shading and detail.
Adjusts the quality of soft shadows. Light sources at long distances will cast softer shadows.
Adjusts the quality of water refraction, reflection and physics.Experienced users can further customize water quality settings in the Advanced section.
Adorn your hands with the finest materials from snakeskin to bear fur. These gloves make a lavish addition to any outfit.
After a break in the weather, the gang have headed down from the mountains, and are now hiding at Horseshoe Overlook.
After a failed attempt at robbery the coward JOHN ROSS STABBED his victim, one Bernard Wilcox, and stole his valuables. WANTED DEAD OR ALIVE.
After a failed robbery, the gang have fled from Blackwater into the Grizzly Mountains, but a late spring storm has left them half frozen and starving. They hole up in an abandoned mining town to lick their wounds and await a break in the weather.
After carefully navigating across the raised trough near the old water tower at Benedict Point, another map was uncovered in the gap between the planks.
After crossing the snowy West Grizzlies, you reach Barrow Lagoon where you discover another Map and some Loot inside a log bridge.
After defending her hideout in Bluewater Marsh, the gunslinger known as Black Belle poses for a photograph for Levin's biography of Boy Calloway.
After depositing FORGED BILLS in the amount of $2,000 and being questioned in their authenticity, these men TOOK TO VIOLENCE, MURDERING a half dozen officers of the law as well as the bank clerks in the town of RHODES. At large.
After finding Jamie in Cumberland Forest with the Chelonian religious order, Arthur tries to convince him to return to Mary.
After finding success and competing for scores with Dutch's Gang out in the West, the O'Driscoll Boys headed to the plains of Valentine. The gang are known for enrolling new members that are considered to be disposable. The O'Driscoll Boys are renowned for the easy money schemes which often consist of robbing banks, looking for a fun time, and their love of whores.
After floating over a waterfall in barrels and injuring themselves, the two brothers realize how foolish their attempts to prove themselves have been.
After his farm is covered in pig manure, retired gunslinger Emmet Granger fights one last duel.
After hunting a zebra that was a donkey and a tiger that was a cougar and another lion that was just a dog - or I think that's right - I think I've lost track of the whole thing, and an assistant that's a real woman and him a strange English maniac in a dress pretending to be all that he isn't. Remind yourself never to go on the stage.
After lassoing an animal or person from horseback, you can release ~INPUT_AIM~ and the rope will remain attached to them.
After piecing together a map from scraps found near the bodies of the victims, a killer's underground lair is discovered.
After putting him on the train, I bumped into old Reverend Swanson, running off.He's stopped the morphine and the hooch and found himself. We spoke.He was leaving, exiting stage left with me leaving through the trap door, I guess.I know my path is to try to do some little good with all the bad I done.
After putting him on the train, I bumped into old Reverend Swanson, running off.He's stopped the morphine and the hooch and found himself.He told me, I don't know quite what he told me. He told me to be myself, like that's anything worth being. Guess that means doing what I been doing all these years.
After putting him on the train, I bumped into that nun, Sister Calderon, bound for Mexico. She gave me a few home truths about existing in this world and perhaps the next.Maybe I have got something to hope for. Anyway, it all sounded very pretty, and took away all the dread I been feeling.
After receiving a telegram from Sadie, John meets her in Valentine and helps her with some bounty hunting work.
After receiving a tip from Bronte about a trolley station in Saint Denis holding a large amount of cash, Dutch, Arthur and Lenny meet to rob it.
After settling into Beecher's Hope, you can help with the upkeep by pitching in around the ranch.
After spotting a huge bear up by the Dakota River, Hosea and Arthur ride out and track it.
Again doing Mayor Lemieux's dirty work. I think that's how it spelt. His first name is Onry, only he spells it Henri. (Guess my French is nearly as bad as my English). Now I was threatened into threatening a newspaper man into donating to the noble cause of truth and learning. I had to make this guy support a library. He didn't want to. Then he did.

Albert Mason almost pays the ultimate price for his work, after tumbling off a cliff edge while trying to take photographs of flying eagles.
Albert Mason, a wildlife photographer, has his bag stolen by a coyote while setting up his camera.
Alden handed over a note about a coach with a wealthy passenger traveling through Scarlett Meadows.
Alden handed over a note about a well guarded convoy of coaches traveling through Lemoyne.
Algernon Wasp asked you to collect a selection of plumes and orchids and return them to him.
Algernon Wasp asked you to collect some more Alligator eggs and orchids and return them to him.
Algernon Wasp asks for further materials to be used in a commission for Baroness Von Buchwald.
Algernon Wasp, a fashion designer and collector of exotic flora and fauna, asks for assistance in tracking down some rare items for several commissions.
Algernon is distraught after finding out that the Contessa has chosen to marry a postman.

All kinds of hunting and combat gear can be bought and sold at the Gunsmith's store, including weapons, ammunition and more.

All of these constructed illusions, and yet underneath he was just a little boy, naked before the God he no longer quite believed in, nor could quite abandon."I want to hate you, Sergei Denisovic, brother. All successful Bounty Hunters need three things - good aim, good constitution, and a damn good ear.Your Perception will help keep you abreast of the latest news, notifying you of available bounties from further away.
All that nonsense about outlaws is just in books. I have met more railway men than gunslingers here. We could really build a life and a country. You would love it.
All them years wasted earning that stuff!Guess I'll never quite know what happened, but the upshot is, we're on the run, and known to more folks in authority than we would like.
All three pieces of the map have been collected. Use the map to locate the killer's hiding place.
Alligator and snakeskin paneled vest with a choice of cross laced ties or alligator tooth toggles. An original addition to our celebrated line of vests.
Alligators live in the swamp and river delta regions of Lemoyne - in southern Bluewater Marsh and all around Bayou Nwa. They are carnivorous apex predators, feeding on fish, birds, amphibians and mammals. A rifle will pierce through an Alligator's tough, armored body plates. Alligator skins, meat, and teeth are all useful for food or crafting.
Alligators live in the swamp and river delta regions of Lemoyne. They are carnivorous apex predators, feeding on fish, birds, amphibians and mammals. A repeater or a Bow with arrows will pierce through an Alligator's tough, armored body plates. Alligator skins, meat, and teeth are all useful for food or crafting.
Allows volumetric ray count to scale freely with screen resolution to allow for more detailed clouds.
Alphonse Renaud, a traveling doctor, needs help recovering his medical wagon from a group of thugs.
Also called bream or coppernose, this oily, gritty fish is typically pan fried. Cheese is a good bait and can increase strikes.
Also called jackfish, pike are a larger fish, with flaky yet bony meat. They will aggressively strike a river lure.
Also known as Needlenose Gar, the meat is slightly coarse and gritty but surprisingly tasty as early colonists will attest. Swamp lures are favored.
Also known as red eye among rural anglers, rock bass can be pan fried whole for their flaky meat. Try using cheese as bait.
America is looked over by a God that wants every person here to be rich and only showered in the light of the love that is happiness of wealth. It is commonly known that those that do not share in wealth simply take it by force but quickly fall to depravity. However I will teach you how to take the hard work and toil of one man and sell it to another with no earnest or involvement. Making wealth on the backs of others is salvation my friend
American Ginseng is a Health herb. It can be eaten to refill your Health Core or crafted into a Health Cure.
American Paints are work horses, identified by their robust build and distinctive patterned coat. The Overo, Tobiano and a rare Splashed White coat are all found in the wild. A unique Gray Overo coat can also be purchased. Their personality, intelligence and willingness to work make these horses easy to care for. This breed is healthy, with a reasonable amount of Speed and great Stamina; perfect for ranch work.
American Red Squirrels are native to the forested regions of West Elizabeth and New Hanover. As omnivores, their diet consists of small animals such as mice as well as nuts, seeds and mushrooms. Using a Bow with Small Game Arrows will successfully kill the squirrel, but will do less damage to their pelts. Their pelts can be sold to traders, and their meat can be consumed, though it is considered to be rather stringy.
American Standardbred horses are one of the fastest breed making them excellent for racing.
American Standardbreds are race horses, identified by their agile frame, powerful limbs and healthy coat. Both Black and Buckskin coats are found in the wild. A Palomino Dapple and a unique Silver Tail Buckskin can also be purchased. This breed handles well, is easy to train, but can be frightened by loud noises. They are healthy, and their average Stamina allows them to maintain a fast pace for a long time.
Ammo ~BLIP_SUPPLIES_AMMO~, Provisions ~BLIP_SUPPLIES_FOOD~ and Health supplies ~BLIP_SUPPLIES_HEALTH~ can be found around camp. The current stock levels are shown when near the Tithing Box.
Among other crimes, MCCLOUD is known to be responsible for the KIDNAP, RANSOM, and SUBSEQUENT MURDER of the Rogers heir. Very dangerous to approach.
Among the shacks of Butcher's Creek, this buyer is only too keen to buy stolen horses and will sell forged papers.
An ARMY DESERTER who has exacted MURDEROUS “REVENGE” on Lt. Colonel Beauregard Johnson of the US Army, former Commander of the 2nd Saint Denis Regiment Infantry.
An ASSASSIN, WANTED for the PREMEDITATED AMBUSH and MURDER of District Attorney William Lefferts IV of SAINT DENIS and his female companion.
An Oriental horse breed, the Turkoman is a bold horse known for its slender body and high endurance. They have long necks, sloping shoulders and long backs. The small hooves are suitable for traveling on hard and rocky ground. They are hearty horses due to their breeding and horsekeeping in the Orient, where mares lived in herds that were partially wild, escaping predators, enduring harsh weather and foraging for food. The lack of a flowing mane allowed for better use by mounted archers in battle. That, alongside their high speed and sure-footedness, made for a great battle horse across coarse terrain.
An abandoned settlement in the swamps of Bayou Nwa, Lemoyne, often used by gangs as a hideout. Locals believe that the place is cursed and are terrified to step foot in it.
An all-around good horse for farm work and riding, the Kentucky Saddler is a hardy breed. They are not susceptible to disease and afflictions as fancier breeds sometimes are. It is a good horse for families looking to purchase an animal for an adolescent due to their easy and gentle temperament.
An all-purpose Bowie knife with a sharp clip-point blade, steel crossguard, and sturdy wooden handle. Designed for combat, this weapon can give the edge to any close-quarters melee fight, or be used for silent takedowns. For hunters, this is also the perfect weapon for killing and skinning animals. Remember: there are no rules in a knife fight.
An animal may break away from the group or be left behind. They will turn into a straggler and no longer move with the rest of the group.
An area for camp members to manage their horses. Many camp members have strong bonds with their horses and some even keep more than one at a time.
An elegant buckled shoe featuring a pointed toe and thick Louis heel. We have matched each pair with luxurious stockings. Comfortable and striking.
An enduring design, the Sierra boots boast a western heel, thick piping and contrasting vamps and shafts. Fully warrantied.
An exciting card game in which the aim is to score as close as possible to, but not over, 21.
An exclusive hand tooled 2 1/2" sleeked leather Gun Belt featuring a large silver engraved cowboy buckle.
An exclusive hand tooled blackened leather Off-Hand Holster featuring a blackened leather band.
An expansive mountain range, mostly uninhabited because of its high altitude, rugged terrain and harsh winters.
An explorer named Maximo Cristobal Valdespino makes some bold claims about his adventures and exploits. Leaving for Japan the next day, he offers to sell a treasure map.
An extremely rare white egg. These can be found in condor nests high on rocky ledges or inside natural cavities in cliffs.
An iconic style, this neatly cut hat is wool felt with a trim band and short brim. Perfectly natty.
An ideal coat to endure the colder climes, this design with its wide notched lapel and thick cuffs brings a weathered charm to any occasion.
An improved and more dangerous version of the regular Dynamite, with a wider explosion radius and dealing more damage. This will blow up anything in your way, whether it be a vehicle, a large beast or a gang coming after you. This upgraded weapon can be crafted using regular Dynamite, Animal Fat and any type of High Velocity cartridge.
An improved and more dangerous version of the regular Fire Bottle. The more potent and flammable nature of moonshine leads to a wider explosion radius. Light the cloth fuse, throw towards your enemies, and watch the world burn. This upgraded weapon can be crafted by combining Moonshine with Animal Fat.
An improved version of the standard Tomahawk, with leather straps wrapped around to the handle to form a grip. This allows a greater spin when releasing the projectile, causing it to travel through the air faster and gives increases force on impact. This upgraded weapon can be crafted by combining a regular Tomahawk with an Eagle or Hawk Feather.
An informative guide to The Laramie Gang, known for intimidating and terrorizing ranch owners for money.
An informative guide to The Murfee Brood, a reclusive gang known for causing trouble in Beaver Hollow.
An informative guide to the Lemoyne Raiders, a group of politically influenced retired soldiers.
An informative guide to the O'Driscoll Boys, opportunistic misfits who relish in fighting, whores and drinking.
An informative guide to the outlaws, mercenaries, and exiles that make up the Del Lobos gang.
An invaluable remedy for any and all disorders. Serves as a preventative care for all maladies including dyspepsia and constipation. Contains the finest bitters, elderberry roots and fermented rye extracts. A true medical wonder that cures pain when it will not subdue.
An invitation to '' has been requested!The Crew's leadership will accept or decline your request at their leisure.
An old Bowie knife with a solid blade, worn wooden handle and large D-shaped handguard for protection. This weapon was commonly used by Civil War soldiers, and is covered in rust. It was found in a storage room underneath the ruined Fort Brennand in Roanoke Ridge, New Hanover.
An old and rare Hatchet made from a large stone blade, leather straps, and feathers. This melee weapon was found at a Native burial site in Big Valley, West Elizabeth, and was likely used as part of the burial ceremony. This Hatchet can also be thrown.
An old and rare pirate cutlass, with a long snapped blade and decorative golden handguard. This relic was found lodged inside an abandoned boat, run adrift in the swamplands surrounding Saint Denis. With a longer range than most bladed melee weapon, this is still a practical combat weapon despite its age.
An old arrowhead that seems to have never been used. Stamina lasts twice as long when using the bow.
An old favorite. Double breasted jacket of cotton and linen featuring an extra wide collar and neat fitted cut. We cannot recommend the quality of this garment enough.
An old lady who lives alone north of Strawberry is rumored to be sitting on some valuables.
An old man, Jeremiah Compson, asks for some of his possessions to be recovered from his nearby home after it was repossessed by the bank.
An old mining town high up in the western Grizzlies of Ambarino that has been abandoned since the harsh storms of '84.
An old outdoors man and war veteran is thrown from his horse and has it recovered for him.
An old plantation house on the bank of the Lannahechee River in southern Bayou Nwa, previously used as a hideout by the Lemoyne Raiders gang.
An outfit ought to speak of your profile in the community, highlighting your class and profession.
An unbonded horse is already hitched at camp. Hitching this new horse will cause the previous horse to be lost.
An uncommon blue-green egg. These can be found in egret nests high in the trees above swamps and marsh.
An uncommon blue-green egg. These can be found in heron nests along the shore of swampy water, mounted in the surrounding trees.
An uncommon speckled egg. These can be found in spoonbill nests built up in the branches overhanging marshland.
And trapped, brother, trapped.""We are never trapped," said Sergei. "If you learn anything from me, learn that."The spring had been a lonely one for Andrei Denisovic, a terrifying look into the void that would envelop him unless he acted. They looked at each other calmly, both at peace with what was now inevitable. The church bells chimed in the distance. The peasants walked home in the evening twilight. The world was both old and very, very new.
Andalusian breed of horses are tough and aggressive in nature which makes them perfect for hunting.
Andalusians are powerful, compact war horses. They can be identified by their thick mane and tail, strong body and noble head. Both the Dark Bay and Rose Gray coats can be purchased at a stable, while the Perlino can be found in the wild. This breed of horse is courageous and will not be spooked easily. They handle well, with average Acceleration and Speed, and are known for their good Health and increased Stamina, making them great for long journeys.
Andrei Denisovic knew that he must kill his brother, and Sergei, his brother, his beloved partner, the man he loved and hated more than any other, knew that he must die. He was not afraid, for this would save his brother, his brother's family and, ultimately, the estate and all its souls. The eternal life, the truer, better life awaited him, and he was happy to die."Do it, brother," he implored, his sickly yellowish eyes bright and tear-stained.
Angus Oxen can be found on ranches and farms across West Elizabeth, New Hanover and Lemoyne. As herbivores, their main diet consists of common roughage including grasses, hay, and silage. These large mammals can be taken down with either a Bow with Improved Arrows, or a long scope rifle. Oxen hide and horns can be used for crafting.
Animal carcasses can be dropped off to Pearson at ~BLIP_SHOP_BUTCHER~ to contribute to gang supplies.
Animal skins can be sold to a Butcher ~BLIP_SHOP_BUTCHER~. Skins can be stored on your horse for easy transport if there is space.
Annesburg's postal service and railroad station operate out of the same building, a convenient location for mail and freight carried by train.
Annesburg's postal service and railroad station operate out of the same building, a convenient location for mail and freight carried by train. This is where to go if you need a train ticket, have a bounty to pay, or letters or parcels to send.
Annette,I did not want to write this letter. I thought I had been clear at the stable, and clear again when you waited for me outside the general - Harriot was still inside, she still could have seen you! It's a miracle she did not.Now, I know I made promises to you, and I know the time we had was good, but Harriot is my wife, and if she's willing to give me another chance I need to give her and myself that opportunity.
Another body that seems linked somehow to the previous one. More paper in the mouth. Maybe directions to some place. I don't know.
Another body that seems linked somehow to the previous one. More paper in the mouth.Maybe directions to some place. I don't know.
Anthony Foreman of the Foreman Brothers Gang offers coach holdup, stealing, and assassination jobs to those who'll help.
Anthony Foreman, the former leader of the Foreman Brothers Gang, escaped while under sentence for robbery, blackmail and pandering. $85 reward offered if Foreman is recaptured alive and turned in in Saint Denis.
Any bodies found will be reported and lawmen dispatched to investigate. Hide or dispose of bodies to avoid unwanted attention.
Any reasonable individual who has blacked boots, split firewood or followed a plow quickly learns the seasons dull and blend together until, one day, half your life has expired and is entirely devoid of social pleasure.
Any thug can rob a man, but a real professional thief plots for bigger targets. Complete 1 Coach Robbery, 1 Home Robbery, 1 Shop Robbery and 1 Train Robbery.
Anyway, me and all the boys hoped you and Mrs. C were doing swell. She looked mighty pretty in that yellow dress she was wearing when you ate dinner the other night.Your pal,Donal
Appaloosa breed of horses known for their good health, agility and speed which makes them a popular choice for hard labor tasks.
Appaloosas are classed as work horses. They can be identified by their compact frame and spotted or speckled coat. The Blanket, Few Spot, and Leopard Blanket are found in the wild, while Leopard and Brown Leopard coats are purchasable in stables. Their willing and manageable temperament leads to easy handling. This breed of horse is healthy, with a reasonable amount of Speed and great Stamina; perfect for ranch work.
Apparently that weird sketch he gave Arthur, is worth a lot of money and Charles is a world famous artist. The world gets stranger every day.
Apparently that weird sketch he gave me, is worth a lot of money and Charles is a world famous artist. The world is beyond my understanding, that's for sure.
Apparently there's gold or women or something at the root of this, and if it's gold, we want it.Either way, we are so deep in the swamp and so entirely lost ourselves, I hope it will take the Pinkertons and their like a long while to find us. We shall see.In the mean time, a new career path in law seems to await. Seems like amongst our other perils a gang called “THE LEMOYNE RAIDERS” won't take too kindly to outsiders or anyone who ain't living in the distant past.

Appearance is second only to aroma, for nobody prefers trade with someone whose bouquet resembles a ruminant animal.
Approach Madam Nazar  to trigger the Collector role. She will often move location and must be found again if you want to speak with her.
Approach a digging spot ~COLOR_MP_OBJECTIVE~~BLIP_OBJECTIVE~ and hold ~INPUT_CONTEXT_X~ to dig.
Approach the Stranger ~BLIP_AMBIENT_PED_MEDIUM~ and hold ~INPUT_CUT_FREE~ to cut them free.
Approach this KILLER with UTMOST CAUTION! Victims of CASTILLO'S DISMEMBERMENT number in the dozens, at lowest estimate.
April 15th 1887BRAZEN BANK ROBBERYTHREE MEN SOUGHTMajor T. J. Belford has been a cashier at the banking house of Lee and Hoyt for a number of years but nothing prepared him for what transpired last week. “It was about 2 o'clock. Three men, strangers to me, came through the door and walked up to the counter. One of them, the eldest of the three, was a fine talker and engaged me in conversation.
April 2nd 1870,Dear Mr. Compson,I'm afraid there's no more work for you down here at the Plantation. I'm grateful for the help you've given us, and the help your pappy and your pappy's pappy gave us before you. These are trying times for all of us. You are in our thoughts and prayers.Yours truly,Col. J. Nixon,The Ascension Plantation.
April 3rd, 1895Edinburgh UniversityFrom the senior professor in history.Dear Mr. Gray, Thank you for your long and well researched letter regarding your ancestor (forgive me,  I was unclear if he was your great-grandfather or great-great grandfather from your missive) and his ostracizing and emigration from Scotland to the Colonies in the aftermath of the uprising of 1745.
Arabian breed of horses are renowned for their intelligence making them one of the easiest breeds to train.
Arabian horses are a superior class, often kept by wealthy owners. Identified by their dished head and high tail carriage, Black and Rose Gray Bay are purchasable, while the Warped Brindle, Red Chestnut and rare White coat can be discovered. A fiery temperament makes them hard to train but, once broken, they handle well and remain loyal. Their great Health and Stamina, with good Speed and Acceleration, make them the perfect endurance horses.
Architect CLEMENT SMITH is wanted for MURDER. He FATALLY SHOT his contractor during a heated game of poker.
Ardennes are well-built war horses. They can be identified by their bulky body, thick leg feathering and broad head. They are one of the heaviest horse breeds. The Bay Roan and Strawberry Roan coats can be purchased from a stable. This sturdy, brave breed handles well under pressure and will not become agitated while in combat. They are known for being healthy with great Stamina, average Speed and Acceleration.
Ardennes horses are known for their well-built bodies as well as being brave in combat situations.

Arthur Morgan's western style pinch front Gambler's Hat with double braided leather band.
Arthur and Sadie travel to Hanging Dog Ranch to finish business with the O'Driscolls once and for all.
Arthur and the gang must destroy gun emplacements on the coast, and rescue the ship captain, before they can leave the island.
Arthur attends a truce meeting between Colonel Favours and Rains Fall, where Rains Fall hopes to negotiate peace.
Arthur is reunited with the gang at Lakay. Milton arrives with his Pinkertons, and attacks the camp.
Arthur meets Eagle Flies outside Cornwall Kerosene and Tar, and prepares to break in to steal a report on the oil reserves at the Wapiti Reservation.
Arthur passes out in Saint Denis, and wakes up to find a stranger dragging him to the doctor's surgery.
Arthur receives a letter from Penelope Braithwaite, asking for help escaping the clutches of her morally depraved family.
Arthur takes Lenny for a quiet drink in Valentine to help to calm him down after learning of Micah's arrest in Strawberry.
Arthur talks to Alden at the Rhodes train station, looking for information on a shipment of moonshine for the professor.
Arthur visits Rains Fall in Wapiti and they travel to a sacred Native American site in the East Grizzlies.
Arthur visits the Saint Denis police chief to get a permit for Professor Bell's experiment.
Arthur wakes to find the ship being battered by a harsh storm. As the ship sinks, Arthur is split from the gang.
Arthur's dear old friend, the corrupt mayor Mr Lemieux, has himself been threatened by his own assistant - Jean Marc, I think. So I go hunting for Jean Marc.Only Jean Marc is a real believer in truth and honesty and cannot stand his boss's lies. I'm charged with killing him.I cannot do it. Jean Marc is irritating, but the mayor is worse. The

I am in too deep now to start worrying about the morality of politicians. I think we can all assume they have none.
Arthur's friend Algernon is, well I don't know what to say at all about him. Interesting man.
Arthur's lodging is used to store the camp's ammunition supplies. Any camp member is free to take items from this wagon. If supplies are low this may lower the morale of the camp so it is in everyone's best interest to keep the wagon well stocked.
Arthur, Dutch and Bill become temporarily deputized citizens of Scarlett Meadows County as they help Deputy Archibald shut down a moonshine distillery and steal a wagonload of the Braithwaites' moonshine.
Arthur, Micah, Bill and Sean go to meet some of the Gray boys in Rhodes to discuss a security job.

As a pair these two men have STOLEN OVER $1000 worth of alcohol en route NORTH to NEW YORK and are still at large. In previous spottings the men have OPENED FIRE and should be considered VERY DANGEROUS.
As evening shadows draw deeper, casting your fly may catch a bat who is also seeking to sup.
As for Mary, I trust I will not make a god awful fool of myself once more but somehow I imagine I shall.
As long ago as 1860, Mr Macguire was implicated in the so-called Fenian Uprising that swept through Galway, burning three large properties and leaving many dead. To escape capture, he fled to Canada, where he was part of a Fenian raid near the great fall of Niagara, that left 8 people dead. Later, he returned to Ireland, where, despite being wanted for murder, he became a prominent figure in republican politics
As one of the leaders of THE DEL LOBOS GANG which have committed ACTS OF MURDER against officers of the state and deputized sheriffs, and robbed coaches and trains with impunity.The Del Lobos were LAST SEEN NEAR GAPTOOTH BREACH. As the crack of your rifle ricochets off the walls of the canyon and the man lies dead in the distance, the birds go silent in the noonday sun, and yet again King Load has never failed you.
As their final job, the gang ride to Saint Denis to intercept and rob a train carrying army supplies and payroll, headed for the recently destroyed Bacchus Bridge.
At Benedict Point, this buyer is always looking for stolen horses, and will sell forged papers to the thief.
At first glance, many readers find it incredulous that I would include show-off gun tricks more suitable for wild west shows in a book about fugitive recovery. However, perception is everything, and if an adversary sees that you are a master with weapons, they are more likely to come peacefully.Spinning two guns is a flourish of bravado certain to make fugitives appreciate how skilfully you might place a lead pill right between their eyes.
At the request of Beau, Arthur drives Penelope and other protestors through Rhodes as they participate in a women's suffrage rally.
At the turn of the century in America, mind-sets are shifting, adapting, and breaking. The towns and wilds are filled with peculiar characters who just want to talk to you about it. Find and interact with 5 of these Ranters, Ravers and Campaigners.

Aunt Esther's Classic Oatcakes are prepared with wholegrain oats which are naturally delicious for you and your horse, should you be inclined to share.
Australian Shepherd dogs can be found in most towns across the states. Their omnivorous diet usually consists of dog food made up from meat, vegetable matter, and offal. The breeding of Australian Shepherds has made them good sheep herders, especially in mountain environments.

BARBER is a VIOLENT THUG who was hired by a wealthy explorer as a guide for an expedition, only to rob his employer and LEAVE HIM FOR DEAD in the wilderness.
BE IT KNOWN THAT GREAT EVIL LURKS IN MANY PLACES - in a dark hollow, in a woman's heart, in the eyes of a bird of prey, but we bring truth to light and remove the dark evil from our hearts so that we can be safe, thanks to our master. We can be that bird and prey. We can hold an egg up to candle and know if life exists or if it is breakfast. Come feast in Chelonia.
BECOME A FIERCE ADVOCATE of national integrity and a defender against the supernumerary indulgences of a deluded public by purchasing this gun and strongly encouraging them to examine their daily proclivities. Having given into exceptional temptations, libations and licentiousness, isn't it time that you consider your religious bearings? Only through exhaustive study of firearms and the Good Book, while living in a drought stricken town where the mercury nears or exceeds the hundred mark at all times of night or day, can you obtain the profound enlightenment that comes from cogitating on moral fortitude. This unique revolver, with its second barrel for buck shot, is so strong and so perfect in manufacture, we have yet to record one that has become shaky or loose. Fire fifty thousand rounds with flawless accuracy and you will see.
BEWARE THIS COUPLE! They have been known to present a false front, with VIRGINIA playacting a lady in distress and SHANE lying in wait to ambush. WANTED for ROBBERY, ASSAULT and MURDER.
BLAKE is a VINDICTIVE KILLER who robbed a general store and CAPTURED a deputy that attempted to stop him, DRAGGING the unfortunate lawman and father of four behind his horse for many miles before leaving him to DIE IN THE SUN.
BRIGANDS, MURDERESSES and SUSPECTED DEVIANTS, every member of this so-called “sisterhood” of the southern states is WANTED DEAD OR ALIVE by federal order.
BROOKS is a military imposter, WANTED for posing as a cavalryman and ROBBING travelers under the guise of collecting a tax, KILLING two who doubted him. WANTED ALIVE or DEAD for the good of the country.
BY ORDERING THIS SUIT TODAY, IT CEMENTS THAT YOU ARE A MAN OF VIGOR AND FERTILITY, WITH HARSHNESS OF CHARACTER IN A FIRM AND BALANCED WAY, HEIGHTENING YOUR CHARM TO ALL AROUND YOU.
Back in a few days. Gone to pick up Mildred from her mother's house. The new Mrs. Peyton!Best,Jim
Band collar, cuff sleeves and button front with a neatly gathered waist. This garment is equal in appearance to ones sold at retail for twice the price, which is a shameful practice.
Band-tailed Pigeons can be found in the damp forests of West Elizabeth. Their omnivorous diet includes berries, grains, fruits, shrubs, pine nuts, and insects. An effective way to kill or wound a pigeon is with a Bow with Small Game Arrows. Their feathers can be used for crafting, and the carcasses can be sold.
Banded Collar Overshirt. Cotton. Half front button dress shirt featuring an inset bib and band collar. Without any exception one of the finest values in America.
Banded collar Everyday Overshirt. Cotton half front button shirt featuring a breast pocket and band collar. This is the very best shirt that human skill can contrive.
Banded collar Overshirt. Cotton. Half front button dress shirt featuring an inset bib and band collar. Without any exception one of the finest values in America.
Bart Cavanaugh has been declared an OUTLAW in the province of STRAWBERRY.It has been definitely ascertained that Cavanaugh is guilty of multiple accounts of assault, intimidation and the wanton destruction of property.Last seen near GNARLY ROCK.
Bart Cavanaugh is wanted dead or alive for multiple accounts of assault, intimidation and destruction of property. A $60 reward is offered for bringing him in.
Based on our most popular in-house design we present this single breasted round cut vest displaying double angled welt pockets. A must have for today's sharp woman.
Bay Bolete is a Health herb. It can be eaten to refill your Health Core or crafted into Herbivore Bait.
Be on the lookout for a muscular ruffian of this foul appearance. He wields a variety of firearms and a distinctive lasso. Thought to be travelling amongst a caravan of vagabonds.
Be on the lookout for a wanted criminal of this appearance. He is a mangy ruffian with a foul temperament. If you see this man report him immediately to your local constable.
Be warned, despite their STRANGE APPELLATION, there is nothing naive or inexperienced about these men, nor are they any longer confined to the territory of AMBARINO. RUTHLESS CUTTHROATS, their ambitions for BLOODY ANARCHY across the south must be QUASHED.
Before he can purchase Beecher's Hope, John must inspect the land and move on any illegal tenants. Back in Blackwater he runs into an old friend.
Before metallurgy was perfected, hunters often threw sharp sticks. Once crafting knives from metal became commonplace, throwing knives emerged as a useful tool for hunting or self-defense.Increasing the accuracy of your throwing knife is a simple process and produces results.
Before replaying a mission, the game will create a restore point. Once the replay has ended you will be returned to this point. Do you want to continue?
Before they can rob the Saint Denis bank, Dutch convinces Arthur that they must kill Bronte. They visit Thomas, a local fisherman, to procure a skiff for the assault on Bronte's mansion.
Being back in this country made me dig up Arthur's old journal again.Odd few years wandering. Now back here, this country that we ran to when things went crazy all those years ago.My mind is full of ghosts. Been a tough few years. Jack don't like me, and Abigail cannot stand me, or is it the reverse.
Belgian Draft Horses are a strong member of the draft horse breed. They can be identified by their muscular build and chestnut glossy coat. Their powerful build makes them perfect for pulling wagons and heavy carts, though their weight makes them harder to handle. They are considered to be a healthy breed with better Stamina and Speed compared to other draft horses.
Belgian Draft horses are known for their powerful and strong build making them great for forest or farm work.
Believed to LIVE ALONE in the SWAMPS of LAGRAS for the last TWO YEARS after the MURDER of a fellow employee at the LEMOYNE TRADING COMPANY.Spotted dressed in SHABBY CLOTHING and reported to be MENTALLY UNSTABLE due to isolation.
Believed to be brother and sister, they are WANTED for the KIDNAP and MURDER of the sweet Billy Miles, a boy of a MERE TEN YEARS of age.
Believing himself a PROPHET, this MADMAN compels WEAK-MINDED FOLK to follow him, and KILLS those he judges unrighteous. Good money to whoever sends him to HIS OWN JUDGMENT.
Berkshire Pigs can be found on ranches and in towns across New Hanover. As omnivores, their diet consists of mice, eggs, agricultural crops, fungi, roots, and grasses. A repeater, or a Bow with arrows, is considered to be the most effective weapon to use when hunting pigs. The tender meat is perfect for cooking, and their skin can be used for crafting.

Betty Sue & Bobby's Horse Reviver is an extraordinary curative compound for seriously incapacitated or injured horses. Complete satisfaction guaranteed.
Betty Sue & Bobby's Potent Horse Medicine is the strongest and most potent compound for all horse troubles and maladies. Complete rejuvenation guaranteed.
Big China Pigs are found on ranches and in towns across New Hanover. Their omnivorous diet includes, mice, worms, eggs, grasses, fungi, and roots. It's considered that the best weapons to hunt pigs with is a Bow with arrows, or a repeater. Their skin can be used for crafting and their tender meat is a good source of food.
Big Valley Apricots. The finest choice and quality fruits picked at peak ripeness and canned in a light syrup that is delicious.
Big Valley Peaches. Since 1832. Our peach orchards produce top quality juicy peaches, even in years of pestilence and drought.
Big Valley Pineapples. A taste of sunshine in every bite. Harvested by hand and quickly canned. Product of Guarma.
Big Valley Strawberries. Juicy, delicious, perfect for confections and pies, or feeding to a young paramour in the park.
Bill starts a brawl in Smithfield's Saloon in Valentine as Javier, Charles and Arthur attempt to charm the locals.

Black Belle, the infamous gunslinger, is hiding out in Scarlett Meadows. She will offer break out, robbery and assassination jobs to anyone willing to dirty their hands.
Black Rats can be found in Saint Denis and other highly populated areas. As omnivores, they scavenge for any scraps they can find, including seeds, leaves, agricultural crops and fungi. Rats can be easily killed or wounded with a Bow with Small Game Arrows. Their meat is stringy but edible, and their skin can be used for crafting.

Blackcurrant is a Dead Eye herb. It can be eaten to refill your Dead Eye Core or crafted into Snake Oil.
Blackened 3" tanned and oiled leather Gun Belt featuring a silver engraved horseshoe buckle and custom studded pattern.
Blackened deer hide Fringed Shotgun Chaps featuring two front pockets and rawhide fringes.
Blackened leather Gun Belt, cut and neatly embossed and featuring a faux gold stud and square buckle.
