The new Lancaster Repeater is of sound construction intended to prevent snow, rain, pine needles, tobacco, dust, sand, cow excrement and other debris from entering the shooting chamber. It is the gun that won both the West and the South from ne'er-do-wells. A wise man once said “It is better to keep your mouth closed and your Lancaster at the ready, in case you have to shoot off either.”
The new Peeters & Janssens Semi-Automatic Pistol deals less damage than revolver sidearms, but makes up for it by doing away with the need for weapon cocking, as well as an expanded ammo capacity and quicker magazine reloads. This gun has an ammo capacity of eight rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive pistol ammo.
The new and improved Evans Repeater is the highest grade repeating rifle ever turned out by B.D. and Co. Its unique design was invented by a dentist which, as most will well attest, is a disturbing profession that savors great pleasure inflicting unwanted trauma and demagoguery on others. It is well known that this fine mechanized firearm requires little academic aptitude. Simply shout a sobriquet, pull the trigger and repeat. We have given this gun the highest mark of perfection.

The postal service and railroad company share an office at this provincial ranch station.
The postal service and railroad company share an office at this provincial ranch station. It's a place where you can send and pick up mail, purchase train tickets and pay off bounties. You can often find a group of locals who meet here to play dominoes, and join them for a game.
The postal worker who handles the mail for the Rhodes area also sells train tickets, as the depot is conveniently located inside the station. Additionally, you can pay bounties here should you need to.
The powerful Hutton & Baird Schofield is an accurate revolver with high damage, making it the best choice for any serious gunslinger. Despite a slow firing rate and reload speed, when compared with other revolvers, it can still be dual wielded to great effect. This gun has an ammo capacity of six rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive revolver ammo.

Truly, the easy unction for such a self-imposed wound is simply acquiring another, which those who have never experienced hardship and hunger can easily do with unlimited means.

This Lancaster Repeating Shotgun is nationally recognized as the strongest shooter in the market. They are made on the strongest and most improved mechanical lines. The best materials are used as often as possible and only skilled mechanics are used when available. There is no better marvel at target and penetration. Professional sportsmen and enthusiasts agree to the weight, power and usefulness of this gun when capturing dinner, securing donations, or courting a maid. It is extra strong, weighty, and compact, yet light. You will barely feel it in your hands until it goes off, and then Lord Almighty you will say prayers to God first and Lancaster soon after.
This NOTORIOUS GANG of DESPERADOS are wanted for MULTIPLE MURDERS and BARBARISM, including CRUELTY TO ANIMALS.

This RUTHLESS husband and wife are WANTED for the attempted robbery of a bank and the KIDNAP of its manager, Mr. Theodore Smith, whom they HANGED FROM A TREE once his usefulness had expired.
This WILD WOMAN is wanted for PUBLIC OBSCENITY and the PHYSICAL ASSAULT of two women with a RAW CHICKEN. Nor is this the first time she has perpetrated such a crime. A previous marshal sent in her pursuit was VICIOUSLY ASSAULTED.

This breed of dog with its distinctive wavy coat is commonly found on ranches and in towns across the states. It is an intelligent breed, loyal and protective.

This hardy breed hails from South America, where in 1540 a shipment of pure-bred Spanish Andalusian stallions were set free as the Spaniards abandoned Buenos Aires. The feral horse population that resulted was able to live in extreme heat and cold with little water or grass. They are an intelligent breed, averaging 14-15 hands high, and have high endurance and stamina, making them perfect for the traveler who is required to go long distances over rough terrain.
This heavy but hardwearing coat features thick woven fabric, fur collar, flap pockets and reinforced button tabs. Fully warrantied.

The Bulrush plant, also known as cattail or water sausage, is distinctive by its long cylindrical mass of flowers.

This previously belonged to Micah Bell, but he won't be needing it anymore. This gun has an ammo capacity of six rounds, and can use Regular, High Velocity, Split Point, Express and Explosive revolver ammo.
This old and worn Hatchet has a flat edge along one side of the blade and is designed for hewing, the process of converting logs into lumber. This melee weapon was found in a tree stump near Moonstone Pond in the Grizzlies, next to an abandoned shack. This Hatchet can also be thrown.
This one-stop shop has a wide range of items, food and beverages, medicines, and even clothing available to purchase from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue. The storekeeper will also buy any items that you don't need.
This one-stop store has a wide range of items available to purchase from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue. The storekeeper will also buy any items you don't need.
This open-air Butcher's stall offers fresh and cured meats for sale. You can sell meat, skins and carcasses to the butcher here.
This open-air butcher's stall offers fresh and cured meats for sale. You can also sell meat, skins and carcasses here.
This outfit is truly unmatched and of great charm and popularity, and suits you perfectly. You are well-bred and dignified enough to purchase ready-to-wear clothing rather than donning some homespun frippery no doubt sewed in a room with a dirt floor and overflowing chamber pots.
This outfit will surely garner the earnest attention you seek and deserve. Is today not the day that you cease to induce indifference and contempt in passers-by mortified at your fashion failures?
This pair of NOTORIOUS counterfeiters KILLED TWO Pinkerton agents during a raid on their operation in THIEVES LANDING. On the run and DANGEROUS.
This percolator is of solid, sturdy construction and will deliver a strong cup of coffee in the morning, warming your hands as you look over the mesa into the valley below and what awaits you.
This person can be challenged to a duel. If you make the challenge, you will be asked to get into position to begin.
This pistol is the finest creation from Hutton & Baird – direct from the factory via our warehouse. It is one of the strongest pistols ever produced. Hold it to your ear upon firing and see. Imagine your delight and surprise upon losing your hearing for well on a month when you realize the sure power of this finely manufactured pistol. Imagine riding along, singing into the blue distance with the Hutton & Baird Volcanic Pistol at the ready, just challenging any creature to cross your path with imprudence or impatience. Choose your ammunition wisely. All shrewd and smart governments have begun to use finely manufactured full metal patched bullets in war, the benefit being that they will not shatter or tear the bones of man when he is hit. Rather, they disable the man, leaving him after wartime to tell all that will listen far and near the folly of making enemies with an original descendent of the 13 colonies.
This place made me feel like I was being watched. Queerest feeling I ever felt. Hard to explain. Fascinating and awful and seductive, all at once.
This police station serves the Blackwater region. You can check in to see if there are any bounties available.
This popular Saloon has a selection of beer and whiskey to offer the thirsty Blackwater resident.
This popular saloon has a selection of beer and whiskey to offer the thirsty Blackwater resident, as well as meals cooked to order. Guest rooms and baths are available here, and you can try your luck in a game of poker or blackjack too.
This portrait has been confirmed a good likeness of LEWIS, the professionally trained shootist responsible for the SUPPOSEDLY "IMPOSSIBLE" KILLING of industrialist James Brice in his guarded compound.
This post office serves the Roanoke Ridge region and you can pay bounties, check the local bulletin board, or send and receive mail here. Room rental and bath services are also on offer, upstairs in the same building.
This refined loose front shirtwaist exhibits unrestricting sleeves with round cuffs for comfort. Ideal for wear during the workday or evening devotional.
This respectable establishment is your premier destination for liquor and entertainment in the Scarlett Meadows district.
This respectable establishment is your premier destination for liquor, food, baths, and entertainment in the Scarlett Meadows district. You can join a friendly game of blackjack and even stay the night here.
This respected businessman became a MURDERER when he KILLED a store clerk after a dispute. Fugitive and ARMED.
This revolver is revered by the Army and Navy who attest that the cylinder catch and barrel latch make for easy shell extraction and loading in the field when enemy tribesmen need to be dropped at close range. It has simply the best action of any revolver for the price, and when you order one you will be the judge and jury and very likely the executioner. Our famed nickelling and bluing department also offers a fine finish resulting in a revolver unexcelled, and if equalled by any other revolver made we will simply close our factory and put it to the torch.
This reward will be paid upon presentation of him alive or with positive proof of his demise.H.THOMAS, Rhodes Sheriff Office.
This riffraff shouldn't pose too much of a problem. Teach this fool how we deal with troublemakers around these parts.
This rifle is a favorite among those full of years and wisdom who enjoy the pleasures of shooting from afar. It is bespoke for the gentleman that can neither read nor write but understands the resolute message a bullet from a great distance can impress on others that you would have join the angels. Our supply house has sold thousands of these fine models and not one person has written to us dissatisfied. We credit this not to most customers' inability to read or write but instead to the unsurpassed quality of this fine rifle.
This rural railway station has a postal office where you can send and receive mail, pay bounties and check the bulletin board. Train tickets are for sale here too.
This shopkeeper operates a dubious business by the quayside, dealing in disreputable wares.
This slightly run-down saloon offers food and drinks at reasonable prices. Thrillseekers can buy in to one of the regular poker games played upstairs.
This soft leather skirt is naturally warm and weatherproof, with statement stitching and fur detail. Ideal for outdoor pursuits.
This special health tonic combines the medicinal and health restorative qualities of Yarrow with Burdock Root, which is effective as a diaphoretic and blood purifying agent.  Combined with Currant, it is known for reducing anxiety or constipation, treating battlefield wounds, restoring focus, attention, while also returning the patient's health.
This task has marked an area on your map to search rather than a specific location. This does not have to be searched immediately.
This time, Albert Mason seemed obsessed by getting eaten by alligators. Again, he managed to survive much more by luck than by judgment.
This two-toned fingerless glove is a season favorite. With rabbit fur, statement stitching and a striking suede thumb panel, it's certain to catch the eye.
This uncle and nephew pair are WANTED in connection with a series of INCREASINGLY FRENZIED robberies, leaving INNOCENT bystanders DEAD in their wake.
This unwelcoming, rough-and-tumble port town has seen better days. Its founders intended it to be a hub of commerce and trading, but these days it attracts more outlaws and delinquents than honest traders.
This up-and-coming port city is the state capital of West Elizabeth and has experienced significant growth in recent years.
This up-and-coming port city is the state capital of West Elizabeth. New businesses, citizens, and visitors have flocked to the growing town in recent years as valuable lumber and mining concerns have sprung up in the surrounding plains.
This vagabond is on the run from the law. Be on the lookout for a man of this appearance. A reward awaits those who can successfully capture him.
This version compared to the regular Tomahawk adds extra weight to the head of the axe with a large leather wrap. This modification improves the accuracy of the weapon when thrown, allowing it to fly true towards its intended target. This upgraded weapon can be crafted by combining a regular Tomahawk with an Owl Feather.
This was a boomtown, with mostly wooden buildings constructed quickly by settlers heading into the West to seek their fortunes. A recent outbreak of cholera has devastated the once-prosperous town, forcing many businesses to close their doors.
This was in our new camp, high in some nasty country, badlands or as bad as we can find this far to the east.The place we are holed up used to belong to a bunch of murderers.The Murfrees, or some nonsense like that, they call themselves.
This weapon is in poor condition. Maintain your weapons by pressing ~INPUT_QUICK_SELECT_INSPECT~ while they are selected on the Weapon Wheel.

This well-stocked General Store provides the people of Blackwater with fresh and preserved food, a range of liquors, tobacco, grooming products and sundries. You can buy goods from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue.
This well-stocked general store provides the people of Blackwater with fresh and preserved food, a range of liquors, tobacco, grooming products and sundries. You can buy goods from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue, and also sell any surplus items here.
This wide brimmed hat is ideal for sun protection while the pre-torn holes provide excellent ventilation in the heat.
This wonderful shotgun is the most popular model. It has been found to be faultless. Using the most modern long recoil operation, the user need not strain their arms pumping this shotgun. It is a semi-automatic shotgun. When a chambered shell is fired, the barrel and bolt recoil together and the hammer is re-cocked. This shotgun is so easy even a child can operate it. John Hasstens from Oklahoma wrote to us to say “I taught my boy that all you need for happiness is a good horse, a good wife, and a good gun and when one gets ornery then you go sleep with the other one, and if they get really squirrely you can use one to help get rid of the other. My boy and I spend a lot of time discussin' such things and hunting. He is mighty proud of his Brun et Fabre. I gave it to him for his 4th birthday and told him 'son, if you're going to be a man, you're going to have to know how to use this.'”
This world. Pure. Not clouded by idiocy. Not imagining himself as God as so many of us are forced to do, but happy as a child of God.But still my thoughts come upon me like wolves. My needs swamp me. My desires overwhelm me. It is not mortality I now fear but its opposite. That idiot's part of me that attempts to convince me I am above mortal concerns. The foolish part of man that tells him he is immortal. That tells him, that whispers like the serpent,
Thomas agreed to row the gang in quietly to the back of Bronte's mansion so you can pay him a social call.
Thoroughbred horses are renowned for the speed and agility which makes them excellent race horses.
Thoroughbreds are race horses, identifiable by their lean legs, athletic build and deep chest. The Blood Bay and Dapple Gray are found in the wild, while the Brindle coat is purchasable. A unique Seal Brown coat is also discoverable. This breed is famous for Speed and agility, though can be clumsy if pushed too far. Their good Stamina and Acceleration make them perfect for racing short distances.
Those particularly susceptible to Cholera Morbus will find immediate relief. Contains the finest berries, elderberry roots and fermented rye extracts as well as secret ingredients known only to Earl Bodine, who personally concocts each batch. It is a true medical wonder that cures pain when it will not subdue. When all else seems interminable, and the sufferer seeks the final silence rather than enduring endless affliction, Uncle Earl is the guaranteed cure.
Those who prosper in the wilderness are skillful and self-sufficient. Craft 1 cooking recipe, 1 tonic, 1 type of ammunition, 1 hunting item, 1 horse care item, and 1 weapon.
Though modest in size, this General Store is well stocked with all sorts of products and supplies. You can make purchases from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue.
Though modest in size, this general store is well stocked with all sorts of products and supplies. You can make purchases from the Wheeler, Rawson & Co. catalogue, and can also sell your items here.
Though some history books may indicate otherwise, the Litchfield Repeater was an instrumental part of the success of the battle against the murderous Indians who intended to disrupt the way of life of peaceful settlers and railroad surveys and discovery of gold and oil on Indian land of which they had no use. When the U.S. Army's 7th 5th Cavalry and the honorable Lieutenant Colonel Joseph Everett Yarbrough sought to discuss matters peacefully, a skirmish broke out, and thanks to the Henry Repeater, many of the combatants were killed. Sadly, Yarbrough was not supplied with enough Henry Repeaters and all perished that day. We offer this repeating rifle as a memento to the brave men that perished defending decency, honor, gold and oil prospecting and working in an effort to bring civilization to the uncivilized. It is a welcome addition to any wagon train, homestead, or cattleman. Bloody skirmishes by Indians occur daily in this country, and only one rifle will protect you and your family where others are doomed to failure.
Though their leader, the infamous “gentleman” BUSTER MAY, has met with JUSTICE at the bottom of short drop, his six lieutenants are still at large. LEADERLESS, GRIEF-STRICKEN and VENGEFUL, they must be CAPTURED or KILLED WITHOUT DELAY.
Thousands are being benefited where medical skill and science have failed.  Dr Claussen's Cumberland Mountain Bitters treats malaise, cures fatigue and quickly renews vigor.
Threatened me in order to make me threaten some art professor on his behalf. Why? So the art professor will verify that a bunch of paintings ain't the forgeries he believes, they are the genuine article he thinks they aren't, in order to fill the people with joy that they are looking at a real work of genius,
Through bad decisions and bad luck, not everyone will survive this difficult journey. After they pass, pay your respects and find the graves of 9 fallen companions.
Tired of your skirts and petticoats trailing in the mud? Reduce laundry and show off this new heavy velvet design. Please note that this skirt exposes the ankles and is not suitable for formal gatherings or church.
To Arthur, Thank you again! I hear Hobart has disappeared and his people have stopped their search for me! I am getting my life back on track now, and have enclosed some amount of money.  I'm not sure what you found in the crypt, but it has helped free me. Regards, Brenda.
To accomplish this fine shotgun, we secured as manager one of the finest gun makers in the country, a gentleman who boasts his works have been an instrumental element in both the beginning and the end of nearly all train, coach and bank robberies. This fine shotgun is famous for ending the lives of many famous gunslingers and outlaws. When you go in a party across the mountains, plains and passes of this great land, there is only one thing that can guarantee your safety, and that is the Double-Barreled Shotgun from D.D. Packenbush. Believe that.
To become a Bounty Hunter, meet Sheriff Gray and purchase a Bounty Hunter License from him or from any Bounty Board.
To become a Trader, collect and read Cripps' letter. Then, choose to help fund his business venture or purchase the Butcher Table from the Wilderness Outfitters.
To board the train, ride your horse alongside it and hold ~INPUT_HORSE_SPRINT~ to match its speed. When the prompt appears, press ~INPUT_JUMP~ to jump to the train.
To conciliate concerns of unjust severity regarding the breathability of passengers in the Bounty Wagon, ventilation slats are provided in this new model so that they may gaze on those enjoying the fruits of freedom. We regret any incidents that accompanied our previous Bounty Wagon as it gave rise to unpleasant complaints regarding bounties expiring before delivery, to great financial distress.
To convince the camper to let you sit down, stand next to him and press ~INPUT_CONTEXT_Y~ to give him whiskey.
To dump the contents of the box repeatedly tap ~INPUT_CONTEXT_Ys~To carefully search box contents hold ~INPUT_CONTEXT_Y~.
To equip the Binoculars, hold ~INPUT_OPEN_WHEEL_MENU~ then press ~INPUT_SELECT_NEXT_WHEEL~ to select the Item Wheel
To equip your Binoculars, open the Item Wheel and page through the items in the Kit slot by pressing ~INPUT_RADIAL_MENU_SLOT_NAV_PREV~ or ~INPUT_RADIAL_MENU_SLOT_NAV_NEXT~.
To get back at the Braithwaites, Tavish Gray asks Arthur, John and Javier to steal prized horses from Braithwaite Manor that he claims will sell for $5000.
To he who finds this,I am told, by those who attend my shows, applauding mightily, throwing flowers upon the stage when I perform in San Francisco, or Chicago, St. Denis, or New York, that I should be the happiest, gayest person alive. That when the curtain closes, and the roar of applause engulfs, and we walk back out on stage for a bow, I should be basking in adulation. Instead, I am riddled with despair.
To hogtie a target, quickly approach the target and press ~INPUT_HOGTIE~. If you don't hogtie the lassoed target, that person will break free after a few seconds.
To keep in good health, a man requires 2-3 pints of water per day. Besides a full canteen, the diligent frontiersman also travels with a bottle of spirits which can be used as an anesthetic, to clean wounds, for trade, or in dire circumstances as a flaming projectile to spectacular effect.
To lasso a target, equip your lasso like any other weapon, aim at the target with ~INPUT_AIM~ + ~INPUTGROUP_LOOK~, and press ~INPUT_ATTACK~ to hurl your lasso.
To look through the barrel at both ends before and after loading. Look through the end of the barrel and make sure the mechanism is working correctly while activating the trigger. Many choose to load their own shells. Shooters often debate the proper method of preparing, loading and firing their wads, however follow these instructions and you will never burst a gun barrel. Pay close care to the size of your wad. Do not accidently put two loads in the same shell. Do not accept the wad of a friend. If you pay special attention to placement of your load and wad, your shooting will be the delight to not only you and those around you.
To perform a stealth kill, approach the target from behind while crouching and press ~INPUT_MELEE_ATTACK~ with the knife equipped.
To plant a placeable explosive, select it from the Weapon Wheel and place it on the ground with ~INPUT_ATTACKs~
To prepare a stimulant for your steed, place two of each item in a metal cup and boil over fire.Pour contents into small bottle, cork and store.
To prove their business credentials to the Emerald Ranch fence, Seamus, Arthur and Hosea attempt to rob a stagecoach from Old Bob Crawford at Carmody Dell.
To put on the bandana, press and hold ~INPUT_OPEN_WHEEL_MENU~, then press ~INPUT_SELECT_NEXT_WHEEL~. Select the bandana item with ~INPUTGROUP_RADIAL_MENU_NAV~ to toggle the bandana disguise.
To read the letter from Cripps and progress in the Trader role, hold ~INPUT_OPEN_SATCHEL_MENU~ and open the letter from the Documents section.
To respond to a camper's story,Press ~INPUT_INTERACT_POS~ to respond positivelyPress ~INPUT_INTERACT_NEG~ to respond negatively.
To round up stragglers, you can shout at or ride close to them to encourage them back towards the group.
To row forwards, hold ~INPUT_VEH_BOAT_ACCELERATE~. To row backwards, hold ~INPUT_VEH_BOAT_BRAKE~. Steer using ~INPUT_VEH_BOAT_MOVE_LR~.
To sell a pelt stored on the back of your horse, take your horse close to the Butcher's stall, focus on the Butcher, and hold ~INPUT_SHOP_SELL~.
To sell a pelt stored on the back of your horse, take your horse close to the Trapper's stall, focus on the Trapper, and hold ~INPUT_SHOP_SELL~.
To sit at the campfire, dismount your horse, and press ~INPUT_CONTEXT_Y~ near an open spot to take a seat.
To take off the bandana, press and hold ~INPUT_OPEN_WHEEL_MENU~, then press ~INPUT_SELECT_NEXT_WHEEL~. Select the bandana item with ~INPUTGROUP_RADIAL_MENU_NAV~ to toggle the bandana disguise.
To the REGRET of all peaceful citizens, the truce between the RIVAL GANGS of JOHN FORBES and WALTER SPARROW continues. Their HATRED of each other being the only check on their BLOODLUST, their combined front must be stopped, by force, at ANY and ALL COSTS.
To track your Collector Rank and unlocked items, visit Roles in the Progress section of the Pause menu.
To use placed dynamite, hold ~INPUT_AIM~ to aim at the intended location. When close, press ~INPUT_ATTACK~ to place the dynamite.
Tobacco companies have always known how to market their wares. Be it with a billboard, or a competition to collect a full set of souvenir cards from cigarette packs. Find discarded cards or get hold of premium packs to assemble one of the sets. Collect 1 Cigarette Card Set.
Tomas, a skiff captain living by the dangerous waters of Lagras, offers work including repossession, delivering supplies and hunting the predators nearby.
Too much cannot be said for the shooting qualities of this wonderful pistol. In fact, the employees here at Wheeler, Rawson and Co. often struggle for words when filling the pages of this catalogue. Nothing has been spared to make this gun the equal of any gun made worldwide, regardless of price. Every part was meticulously milled, crafted and refined by Germans, who are known for their joy of tedium in manufacturing. And with the high caliber .44 repeating shots, rest assured that you are employing the strongest cartridge available and that when you fire this gun everyone within several miles will be in awe.
Too often people wear clothing that gives them an ill-bred air of coming from a lineage of progenitors, forever bungling through carnal acts with any misanthropic wretch within the throw of an extinguished whiskey bottle.
Took McDaniels in, and watched him fry. Weren't very nice. Weren't very humane.The professor got upset, and got involved before possibly killing himself with electricity. And I never got paid $ $. If they catch me, I pray they hang me. That chair is the work of the devil.
Took a day off and went off hunting with Hosea. He really seems to be getting his strength back a bunch, although he was lucky not to die as this big bear he'd been after turned on us.I thought when we was stuck up in the mountains that the cold and the misery would kill him, and we'd bury him like we buried Jenny and Davey.But he pulled through and he'll live a while yet.
Took medicine to that creepy pair as they'd poisoned themselves real well. They survived for now. Strange pair they are.
Took medicine to that creepy pair as they'd poisoned themselves something proper. They survived but I doubt they'll make it for much longer. Like a pair of circus clowns.
Took the shine to the fella in Saint Denis. A professor no less. Andrew something or other. He's built an electric chair as a kind way of killing folk as needs killing. Oh, the irony of it all. Even more ironic, me so tough and him so weak and I never got paid.
Took young Jack out fishing as a favor to Abigail. Many years ago, before she fell so hard for that fool MARSTON, perhaps I should have married her. I think part of me has always thought that, yet, God damn you, Mary!Jack is a good boy. A dreamer. A boy with a momma who loves him. I wonder if he will find what we seek - peace and truth away from all this nonsense and lies. If that is what we still seek? Not that that's a new development. Not sure I know myself anymore.
Top quality 3" Gun Belt with treated leather, luxury snakeskin, fancy buckle and rattlesnake motifs.
Traced back to medieval times, the breed is fantastic for pulling wagons. The neck is short and very muscular. The back is short and broad. While excellent working animals, they are also suitable for riding. Belgian Draft Horses are frequently used in forestry as they can pull a felled tree or obese family member a great distance. When slaughtered, their meat is tender and highly sought after, though the Belgian people prefer beer, bivalves and French fried potato sticks.
Traders manage their very own businesses from Camp, selling goods and supplies to neighboring areas for profit.
Training your horse to pick up plants in its mouth and pass them to you does not convey a lackadaisical demeanour.It's smart. And it's this kind of smart that separates successful collectors from amateur hobbyists. Once you have successfully taught your horse this trick, it is helpful in other cases, such as when you want to pick a flower for a lovely maiden.The latter hasn't happened yet, but when it does I shall be ready.
Trains can be lucrative robbery targets. You can board the train while it's stopped or jump on it from horseback to rob it.

Traversing the wilderness, riding through settlements, and exploring cities, you never know what you might stumble across. It could be a test of your character, or a test of your mettle. Have 25 Chance Encounters.
Trelawny causes a distraction as Arthur robs a stagecoach in Scarlett Meadows following a tip-off from a discouraged worker at Rhodes post office.
Tricolored Herons can be found in the wet and grassy marshlands of Lemoyne. As carnivores, they prey on fish, insects, amphibians, and crustaceans. The Varmint Rifle is considered to be the best weapon for a clean kill. Heron plumes can be used for crafting and their meat can be used for cooking.
Trophy size pickerel can be up to 30 inches and large specimens live in the Dakota River. They favor special river lures.
Trophy size smallmouth are known to live in Owanjila and hit special lake and river lures.
Trophy sized trout are in the waterways around Willard's Rest and prefer special lake and river lures.
Try to maintain a constant speed behind the animals. Some animals are naturally slower and you should match their speed to avoid trampling them.
Try your hand at Poker, the popular card game of skill and strategy. The aim is to collect chips either by having the best hand of cards, or by bluffing so that the other players drop out.
Try your hand at Poker, the popular card game of skill and strategy. The aim is to collect chips either by having the best hand of cards, or by bluffing so that the other players drop out. The rule set is called Texas hold 'em. The house takes a 5% rake on all pots over 20 chips. Tables can accommodate up to 6 players, and new players who sit down will join at the start of the next hand.
Try your luck at poker, the popular card game of skill and chance. The aim is to win chips either by having the best hand of cards, or by bluffing so that the other players drop out.
Turkoman is a multi-class horse with characteristics that make it perfect for racing and combat.
Turkomans are multi-class with characteristics of both race and war horses. They can be identified by their slender but agile build, and also their sleek coat. The Dark Bay, Gold and Silver coats can be purchased from a stable. They handle well, but can often be impatient. They are popular due to their fantastic Health, good Stamina and fast Speed. This well-rounded horse is great for most situations.
Turns out, I'm not very well. Got tuberculosis. Doctor did not know how long I would last. All them bullets shot at me, all them horses threw me, all them fights and it was beating up that pathetic little fella Downes that killed me, I reckon. He's the only man I been near was real sick. He begged for mercy and I beat the bastard and he died. And now I'm dying, too. The way of the world. My mind is racing, of course. That monk I met, Downes's widow, Abigail, Mary,

Two Fist Prairie Moon Gin. High quality gin made with juniper berries and other fine botanicals. The night begins and ends with Two Fist's.
Two brothers seeking adventure in the West, Acrisius and Proetus, have bottles shot off their heads to prove their bravery.
Two members of a traveling sideshow, Bertram and Marjorie, are found arguing about the disappearance of another member of their troop in the Van Horn saloon. After intervening, a fight breaks out with Bertram.
UNDOUBTEDLY, FOR THOSE IN THE PROFESSION OF TRADING ANIMAL SKINS AND PELTS, APPEARANCE IS EVERYTHING, FOR WE ARE VISUAL CREATURES WHO DETERMINE THE TRUSTWORTHINESS OF AN INDIVIDUAL IN MERE SECONDS.
UPGRADE YOUR WHEELER, RAWSON & CO. CLUB MEMBERSHIP TO ACQUIRE ALL THE DEBONAIR STYLINGS AND PROFESSIONAL BENEFITS OF THE WELL-TRAVELED OUTLAW.

Uncle Earl Bodine's is the Great Formula that restores Health and increases appetite. Accept no imitations or home remedies. Proven on infants and the infirmed alike.
Uncle and Arthur head to Hill Haven Ranch to rustle some cattle to sell to Clay and Clive for cash.
Uncle receives a tip-off and rides out with Arthur, Charles and Bill to rob a wagon carrying payroll.
Uncle tells John that he has heard that Charles Smith is alive and in Saint Denis. John and Uncle go to Saint Denis to track him down.
Uncle, John and Charles spend the night celebrating after finishing work on the barn. John wakes to find Uncle has been taken by the Skinner Brothers.
Under the leadership of the NOTORIOUS DOLORES CAINE, these women have repeatedly infiltrated the Supreme Court of Lemoyne, through means unknown, each time painting their DERANGED MANIFESTO on the desk of the CHIEF JUSTICE.
Under the leadership of their leader, JOSEPH ALDO, these men have campaigned through several states on a RAMPAGE of THIEVERY and BOOTLEGGING.
Under the threat of torture, Kieran leads Arthur, John and Bill out to Six Point Cabin where he claims Colm O'Driscoll is holed up.
Unfussy wool chaps with a tie waist. Fully lined with canvas. An essential garment for colder climes.
Unlock unique gameplay as you rank up each Role, uncovering missions, events, challenges, items and more.
Unquestionably, Wheeler and Rawson is the leader among all catalogue concerns in outfitting a wide range of vocations. We take particular pains to furnish those who engage in law enforcement and pursuit of the scurrilous members of our fine society. They, more than most, require dependable tools of the trade, as a flaw in any garment or accessory could result in certain disaster.
Unquestionably, our tradesman attire is the best on offer for this vocation. Do not discredit your womanhood/manhood by donning the dreary rags that other catalogue concerns pass off as workwear. It is impossible to separate clothing from character. The clothing makes the man, or woman, or sometimes men dress as women, as they do in Shakespearean plays in France. Should a blacksmith dress as a jolly steamboat captain? They might, as is their right, however the ensemble should fit the trade.
Until recently, this mountain town was nothing more than a base camp for lumberjacks and hunters, but more settlers and visitors have arrived as the local logging industry continues to grow. A small, isolated community of honest working folk.
Until you pay your bounty, bounty hunters will continue to track you down. Telegraph services are located within each Post Office ~BLIP_POST_OFFICE~.
Unwilling to accept Arthur's money, Edith Downes continues to sell her body. Worried for his mother's safety, Archie Downes asks Arthur to head to Willard's Rest to look for her.
Upgrade Arthur's lodging. Unlocks the fast travel map, allowing you to quickly travel to previously discovered locations. Also unlocks grooming supplies.
Upgrading to The Outlaw Pass will earn Rewards in addition to everything from the free Wheeler, Rawson & Co. Club membership.
Uphill the trees grow bare, seared long agoBy some forgotten fire. The trail turns north.Soon I can see old Hagen capped with snow,Across a tide of lupines rolling forth,And there I leave the path, stretch out my hands,And wade for home across the valley floor.And yet, there's something missing from these lands.Oh come, my Annabella - I implore!
Upon PILLAGING the local hospital for its supplies of morphine, these two DEGENERATES covered their tracks by setting the structure ABLAZE, KILLING a dozen INFIRMED RESIDENTS.
Upon its invention 30 years ago, dynamite was soon realized as a safer alternative to nitroglycerine and black powder, of which improper handling resulted in the creation of more than a few widows. While useful in removing structures or fishing, often times the target is out of range of a thrown piece of dynamite.Use this handy tip to increase its range and effectiveness.
Upon learning that Eagle Flies has been captured by the army, Arthur and Charles infiltrate Fort Wallace to rescue him.
Upon returning to the Sinclair house in Big Valley, Francis Sinclair's mother answers the door, holding a baby Francis in her hands.
Upon returning, found the folk again, at least them as ain't dead. But within a few hours, the Pinkertons had found all of us. Old Agent Milton wants us all dead and yet somehow we survived and are now planning another escape.Not sure what happens next. Whole thing has been hard on all of us. Most of all on Dutch, who seems half crazed by all we gone through.	H.†
Use a less powerful weapon like the Varmint Rifle or a Small Game Arrow to damage the nest and avoid breaking the collectible Bird Egg.
Use everything the wilderness has to offer to survive. Scavenge resources to craft weapons, catch fish and hunt small game.
Use the Bounty Wagon to transport multiple bounty targets. Call out your Bounty Wagon from the Stables option in the Player menu.
Use the Hunting Wagon to transport multiple skins and carcasses. Call out your Hunting Wagon from the Stables option in the Player menu.
Use the Miscellaneous Collector's Map to locate random collectibles. You can only own one at a time, but other maps are available from Madam Nazar's Shop.
Use this post to join a series of showdown modes with a moderate number of players. You can also join the series from the Quick Join section of the Player menu.
Use this post to join a series of smaller showdown modes. You can also join the series from the Quick Join section of the Player menu.
Use your Bounty Wagon to secure bounty targets. You can call out your Bounty Wagon from the Stables option in the Player menu.
Use ~INPUTGROUP_RADIAL_MENU_NAV~ and ~INPUTGROUP_RADIAL_MENU_NAV_CYCLE~ to select the Camera from the Kit slot
Use ~INPUT_RADIAL_MENU_SLOT_NAV_PREV~ or ~INPUT_RADIAL_MENU_SLOT_NAV_NEXT~ to select a stowed weapon from your horse
Used in cooking. Slightly restores Dead Eye Core or slightly restores Horse Health Core.
Used in crafting. A highly poisonous plant. Slightly damages Health and Health Core. Highly poisonous for Horses.
Used in crafting. Slightly restores Dead Eye Core or slightly restores Horse Stamina Core.
Used in crafting. Slightly restores Health Core or slightly restores Horse Stamina Core.
Used in crafting. Slightly restores Stamina Core or slightly restores Horse Stamina Core.
Used in raiding and wartime, Arabians have a very good temperament and are especially suited for use by the young and elderly due to their alertness and eagerness to please. They are fast, quick to learn, and have a willingness for training, though they will not tolerate abuse. Good-natured, they form a tight bond with humans, having been bred for desert living where they are required to live on little food and be exposed to extreme fluctuations in temperature. Whether used for racing, war, or work, they are superior in fitness, strength and agility and exhibit a high amount of grit. Requires a great deal of care, but the owner is rewarded for it.
Using a Collector's Map will reveal up to three Collectible locations on the Pause Map. It can only be used once.
Using the final Map and navigating a treacherous path along a cliff edge between Bacchus and Fort Wallace, you find 3 Gold Bars in a small crevice.
Using the pseudonym 'Jim Milton', John has secured a job as a hand at Pronghorn Ranch, and gets to work.
Using your bow and hunting knife, gather pristine animal pelts. Hunt game, track animals and take on a variety of predators.
Utilizing a .44 caliber centerfire metallic cartridge, there is no more accurate and reliable repeating rifle available from any outfitter at this price. Imagine a rifle that you could spend hours lovingly cleaning by the cook fire on a Sunday afternoon, then load it with cartridges and shoot all week long without having to reload. It is relief from this kind of worry that allows a man to put his mind to larger tasks like understanding the meaning of the universe or finding a handsome woman fit and stout enough to survive a long winter and produce offspring without an untimely death. Such are the concerns to life on the plains; however with this Repeater from Litchfield at your side you can do no wrong, no matter who you turn the barrel towards.
V. Laurent Clark Snake Oil Liniment is prepared using pure rattlesnake oil. This is the genuine article. Do not accept cheap imitations made from lizards or lesser reptiles or amphibians.
VALERIA FLORES and her "Senoras" are responsible for the recent string of DECAPITATIONS along the United States and Mexico border. FLORES is known to KEEP THE HEADS of her victims, leaving the bodies for the VULTURES.
VICIOUS KILLER on the loose! The law seeks out this BUTCHER, infamous for the despicable TORTURE BY SKINNING of over 10 lawmen. Warning: may be found in the company of other such contemptibles.
VICTORIA WEBBER, 42, knowingly FED her husband and his brother CONTAMINATED MEAT, KILLING THEM BOTH. She is now a FUGITIVE and at large.
Valentine's local physician sells various remedies, tonics and pick-me-ups, and will buy any health-related items you have spare.
Valentine's long-established Levi family stables offer a range of horses, along with stabling and grooming services. You can store any horses you've acquired here.
Valentine's long-established Levi family stables offer a range of horses, along with stabling and grooming services. You can store or sell any horses you've acquired here.
Vanilla Flower is a Health herb. It can be eaten to refill your Health Core or crafted into Herbivore Bait.
Vaquero Spurs. Sleeked hand tooled leather boot straps with engraved steel heel band, leg shank and 20 point vaquero rowels.
Verifying game ownership failed and your offline activation data could not be loaded.Please ensure your internet is connected and restart Red Dead Redemption 2.If this issue persists, please contact please contact Rockstar Games Customer Support at https://support.rockstargames.com.
Violet Snowdrop is a Stamina herb. It can be eaten to refill your Stamina Core or crafted into Herbivore Bait.
Violet SnowdropVanilla FlowerParasol, Chanterelle, Ram's Head, or Bay Bolete Mushrooms
Violet snowdrops are a favorite in home remedies.  Combined with Sage and Burdock Root, which purifies the blood and is known to relieve rheumatism, the stimulant effect can be felt for a considerable period. It increases stamina which is advantageous in battle or the bedroom. You can substitute Wild Feverfew if Violet Snowdrop is unavailable.
Violet snowdrops are an aromatic flower dark purple in color with a yellow stamen in a conical ball. Vanilla flowers derive from orchids and are prized for their flavour and aroma. Combined with Mushrooms, it makes an alluring bait.Both are favorites amongst deer, elk, bison, even horses and other game.
Visit Blackwater's premier Tailor for a new look. The Tailor offers new clothing made to measure and can upgrade accessories, given the right materials.
Visit any stable and ask them to retrieve your current horse from the wilderness for a fee
Visit the Butcher's stall for all your meat needs. You can also sell any game you've hunted or fish you've caught to the butcher here.
Visit the Tailor's shop in Saint Denis' historic Harris Square for new clothing and accessories. The tailor can supply individual pieces or full outfits, and upgrade some wearable items too.
Visit the Tailor's store in Saint Denis's historic Harris Square for new clothing and accessories. The tailor can supply individual pieces or full outfits for men and women.
Visit the butcher's stall for all your meat needs. You can also sell any game or fish you've caught here.
Visit the butcher's stall for all your meat needs. You can also sell any game you've hunted or fish you've caught to the butcher here.
Visit your druggist today and buy a bottle. Then serve yourself three teaspoons. Take your watch in hand, and if you do not feel full relief in one minute, demand your money back immediately. Do not be bashful, for they are used to this. When you take a spoon of Doc Crockett's, your ailments fade away like a dream. It is deliciously flavoured and is most delightful and agreeable. You will find yourself taking Doc Crockett's daily, and will wonder how you managed without its curative properties. Refuse substitutes. It is absolutely free of all injurious substances. 
Voyach's original. These field or marine glasses provide you with the highest level of magnifying power. Intended for practical and professional purposes only.
WANTED DEAD OR ALIVE for the STABBING DEATH of the local barber and surgeon, as well as a MURDEROUS ASSAULT upon his son and assistant, in retribution for their BOTCHED OPERATION on her own now-DECEASED son.
WANTED DEAD or ALIVE for TERRORIZING several farmsteads and extorting them for money or valuables upon THREAT OF VIOLENCE.
WANTED DEAD or ALIVE for luring an officer of the peace into a narrow back alley, wherein the lawman was set upon by VINDICTIVE CRIMINALS eager to repay prior slights with VIOLENCE. She is depicted as a taciturn woman of humble appearance.
WANTED DEAD or ALIVE with NO CLEMENCY. CLYDE TURNER has single handedly made the road from BLACKWATER to SAINT DENIS unsafe to travel, REGARDLESS of any expense lavished on protection.
WANTED DEAD or ALIVE, these DEGENERATE SCHEMERS are responsible for the POISONING of various wells and springs, and the sale of MIRACULOUS "CURES" to the inhabitants of nearby settlements.
WANTED DEAD or ALIVE. Five year prison escapee. Believed to be on the run with a large group of young outlaws. VERY experienced shot.
WANTED FUGITIVE! Moonshiner JUNIPER LUCAS caught fleeing from fire in nearby woods in LEMOYNE leaving the bodies of two young women, Abigail and Rebecca Peters, to be CONSUMED BY THE FLAMES.
WANTED KILLER, THIEF, and KIDNAPPER. HUNT is known to target transport wagons, and KIDNAP those he does not MURDER. Survivors bear witness that DEATH would have been preferable.
WANTED MURDEROUS VAGABOND. FRY is a known danger to any who crosses his path. His most recent act of WANTON BARBARISM was DROWNING a man just for his boots. Expect to find him in EVIL company.
WANTED THUG and ARSONIST. STRICKLAND attempted to EXTORT a shop owner by burning his store front. The fire SPREAD TO CONSUME the store, three homes, and two outhouses.
WANTED for AGGRAVATED ASSAULT. HAYES became ENRAGED during a game of five finger fillet and SLASHED Mr. Patrick Lee MULTIPLE TIMES across the face and chest. Mr. Lee now CLINGS TO LIFE. Hayes is known to be armed.
WANTED for BEATING two highly trained soldiers to DEATH with his bare hands while the latter were on leave. BE WARNED, the suspect is a former prizefighter and should UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES be approached unarmed.
WANTED for BLACKMAIL and INVOLUNTARY MANSLAUGHTER. Their forgeries and lies have driven at least one man to take his own life, and they have RUINED COUNTLESS LIVES and fortunes.
WANTED for BLINDING and nearly KILLING her close friend, Miss Agatha Brown, with HOT GREASE.
WANTED for CRIPPLING and NEARLY KILLING a man during the course of robbing him at KNIFEPOINT.
WANTED for ESPIONAGE against the US Government, in his attacks against several governmental installations throughout the territory on behalf of an unidentified foreign agent.
WANTED for EXTORTION, ROBBERY, LARCENY, ASSAULT and BATTERY. This is a VICIOUS and HABITUAL CRIMINAL responsible for countless acts of VIOLENCE and DEGRADATION.
WANTED for FRATRICIDE! Last seen departing the town of VALENTINE shortly after he SHOT HIS BROTHER, Will Barber, DEAD in a disagreement over a cattle auction.
WANTED for GRISLY MURDER! Authorities report HICKOCK and RICKEY are sharp aims and are MERCILESS and WITHOUT FEAR of God. “SAVAGES,” said one deputy.
WANTED for KIDNAPPING and TORTURE of several lawmen and government agents. RUIZ claims to recognize no authority or government, and is often in the company of DANGEROUS KILLERS. A REWARD to those who put an end to his SEDITIOUS WAYS.
WANTED for KIDNAPPING. A REWARD is offered by Mr. and Mrs. Burk of STRAWBERRY after CURT HAMMOND abducted their daughter and LEFT HER FOR DEAD in the wilderness.
WANTED for KILLING his brother, Lyle Hudson, over their father's will. Lyle was STABBED TO DEATH. This is REGINALD'S last known photograph.
WANTED for MANSLAUGHTER and THEFT. BAKER hit and KILLED A CHILD with his horse while making his escape after ROBBING the ANNESBURG BANK.
WANTED for MATRICIDE and PATRICIDE after a DRUNKEN RAMPAGE in which his parents' bodies were DISMEMBERED and their REMAINS SCATTERED throughout the family homestead and fed to livestock.
WANTED for MURDER and SOLICITATION. Caution yourself AGAINST BEGUILEMENT at the hands of TRACY, lest you fall into BEN'S murderous clutches. REWARD for putting an end to their DEPRAVITY.
WANTED for MURDER and THEFT. TODD and two accomplices robbed a train, KILLING the conductor. Thereafter, TODD added those same accomplices to his list of VICTIMS, to avoid sharing the stolen goods.
WANTED for MURDER and THEFT. TUCKER was last seen driving a stolen wagon full of chickens outside of VAN HORN. The wagon driver's body was found shortly after.
WANTED for MURDER and animal cruelty after he TRAMPLED a man, two sheep and a dog while absconding from a bank.
WANTED for MURDER, whereby she endeared herself to a string of PROSPEROUS WIDOWERS through service, only to bring about their DEATHS by means unknown. Believed to be ARMED and DANGEROUS.
WANTED for MURDER. WARD SHOT his neighbor, Jed Pitts, during a dispute about their shared property line. Mrs. Agnes Pitts, now a WIDOW, was INJURED in the ATTACK.
WANTED for MURDER. WILLIS was seen emerging from a farmhouse with BLOOD STAINS, traveling alone. Later examination of the property by authorities revealed the SLAIN Mr. Jacob Beauregard and his wife. Their children were LEFT UNHARMED.
WANTED for MURDER. WILSON repeatedly SHOT Elias Jones, son of John Jones, the latter having ACCIDENTALLY KILLED Wilson's only daughter one year ago.
WANTED for POISONING TO DEATH all but one of the horses of a rival ranch hand, absconding with his remaining horse and few worldly goods. She is depicted with long, soiled brown hair, SALLOW COMPLEXION, and may be armed.
WANTED for REPEATED vagrancy, larceny, CRIMINAL trespass, PUBLIC drunkenness, and LEWD behavior.
WANTED for STABBING a sleeping and defenseless officer of the court until he BLED TO DEATH. Said officer presided over the lawful and WELL-DESERVED EXECUTION of her OUTLAW FATHER, Brian Grace, himself a MURDERER.
WANTED for STEALING the horse of an officer of the law, and the subsequent PHYSICAL ASSAULT of said officer. She also stole his hat and uniform, but agents DO NOT believe she is wearing them.
WANTED for THEFT and ASSAULT. MITCHELL robbed a general store at gunpoint, SHOOTING and MAIMING the right hand of the owner, with whom she was believed to be romantically involved.
WANTED for THROTTLING her fraternal twin sister Emma by the neck over allegations of cheating in a game of whist.
WANTED for a campaign of PUBLIC HARASSMENT against the Honorable Judge David Livingston III of SAINT DENIS, leading to the unfortunate gentleman's DEATH by APOPLEXY OF THE HEART. At large, believed ARMED.
WANTED for a long career as a HIRED THUG on behalf of numerous criminal organizations operating out of SAINT DENIS, CRABTREE is now fugitive and at large.
WANTED for a series of GRUESOME and UNWARRANTED ATTACKS against prominent men of the community throughout SAINT DENIS and its environs.
WANTED for a series of VICIOUS MUTILATIONS perpetrated on young men in and around BLACKWATER. Mr. MOORE has been on the run for some months so may have grown his hair longer, and could well have traveled far.
WANTED for a series of acts of ARSON in pursuance of insurance fraud, and one count of accidental KILLING OF A CHILD.
WANTED for a string of HIGHWAY MURDERS and ROBBERIES, this MEXICAN BANDIT is known to BURY HIS VICTIMS ALIVE. Photo is an older likeness; he is known to wear his hair long in WOMANLY FASHION, upon occasion.
WANTED for a string of robberies, the four women here depicted are known to be ARMED and DANGEROUS. They strike trains and carriages on their overnight shifts, with the stolen money totaling over FOUR THOUSAND DOLLARS.
WANTED for a string of train derailments across the southeastern states, enacted with the INTENT OF LOOTING the wreckage.
WANTED for a swindling operation in which NEARLY A DOZEN citizens bought expensive plots of land out West, and which the federal law subsequently found to be ENTIRELY FABRICATED. Rather than submit to custody, these women have taken up arms, are UNAFRAID TO KILL, and remain at large.
WANTED for acts of VANDALISM against the Central Union Railroad, and the harassment of its staff. BAVARIAN BORN, RAITH was raised AMERICAN, but retains the CHOLERIC TEMPERAMENT of his ancestors.
WANTED for aiding, abetting and escaping with an unidentified man, after they CONSPIRED TO DETONATE the safe of her employer, a wealthy rancher, with LETHAL CONSEQUENCES for the latter. Her associate is BELIEVED DEAD.
WANTED for armed robbery of a stable. SORELY was last seen on horseback, HEADING SOUTH.
WANTED for as many as FIFTEEN MURDERS these two ODIOUS SCOUNDRELS have yet to be KILLED or CAPTURED. All precautions must be taken as they do not travel alone.
WANTED for attempting to derail a train transporting a GUBERNATORIAL CANDIDATE on a local “whistle-stop” campaign tour, after accepting payment from a wealthy but UNDISCLOSED RIVAL to said candidate's platform.
WANTED for cattle and horse rustling on a large scale across four states. WHITE and HARRIS have been working together for two years, and are known to FLAUNT their CONTINUED EVASION of the law.
WANTED for conspiring to SWINDLE GULLIBLE MEN in the sale of a Guaranteed Miracle Hair Tonic that was in truth a TOXIC BELLADONNA. These CHARLATANS are responsible for NINE DEATHS.
WANTED for disguising as a SUICIDE their KILLING of a wealthy but UNFAITHFUL HUSBAND of a local heiress, at her direction, they are also suspects in a number of other HIRED KILLINGS.
WANTED for drunkenly causing HUNDREDS OF DOLLARS in damages, including the RUIN of a saloon piano and the front glass of several shops, and furthermore causing a carriage to WRECK, resulting in the INJURY OF FOUR, and the DEATH of the carriage driver.
WANTED for forgery after caught attempting to pay for goods with PAINTED GRAVEL. Although a PHYSICAL COWARD, SHAW is armed, having sought the protection of KNOWN CRIMINALS.
WANTED for giving aid and succor to the NOTORIOUS Brotherhood of Register Rock, JOSEPH is a retired army corporal more than CAPABLE WITH A FIREARM.
WANTED for her role as a lookout in a bank robbery in which at least two employees were KILLED. Mrs. SHERRY fled in the company of the bank robbers, SHAMELESSLY LEAVING BEHIND her loving husband and family, but was not among their number when they were BROUGHT TO JUSTICE.
WANTED for his part in a FOILED CONSPIRACY to orchestrate a fake kidnapping and secure ransom.
WANTED for his role as wagon driver and henchman in the KIDNAPPING and EVENTUAL MURDER of Eleanor Gatz, daughter of MAYOR Seymour Gatz.
WANTED for horse theft, robbery, assaulting her court-appointed guardian with a DEADLY WEAPON with INTENT TO MAIM, and absconding with her sister Mary, whose BODY was recently discovered on a train passing through the HEARTLANDS.

We aim to illustrate every article honestly and correctly. It serves no purpose to embellish the illustrations in this catalogue. We are well aware should you receive a gun that is not exactly as it is depicted it is quite likely that you will turn it on our agent at the office that sold it to you. Our employees are instructed to treat each and every customer just as they would like to be treated, and suffice it to say our employees don't enjoy having new holes opened up in them.
We are aware there are some who only order from other catalogue concerns. These lost souls often speak in harsh monotonous sounds and move curiously, as if an obstruction restricts walking or making night soil. Indeed, only a funambulist would peruse those fat, dreary tomes which are ideally suited for kindling or the bottom of aviaries. Order this ensemble today, with haste, and it will become abundantly clear that, indeed, Wheeler and Rawson are the arbiters of excellence.
We are compelled to exhaust a subject and encourage our customers to do the same. Stand on a street corner with this catalogue in one hand, hold it high and proclaim to everyone within earshot that they shall be saved should they listen to the Good Word. There are those struggling with faith, failing to keep temperate, enumerating passions for wine and song, ordering from any catalogue that should spread its pages. There is only one true catalogue, and it is Wheeler and Rawson, and those who believe shall have everlasting life, surrounded by the fineries of heavenly commerce. Amen.

We are in complete confidence as to our unique ability to furnish you with the finest repeating shotgun on the market that we encourage you to take the Lancaster ten day challenge. We are willing to send you this fine Repeating Shotgun on our regular terms and encourage you to ride from the highest points in the valley to quick running streams, from Sunday market to cottonwood swamp, through fields and towns and fire this gun at everything within sight, sound or perceived slur for test, trial and absolute comparison at least 10,000 times. If you have any reason to be dissatisfied with this experience, you can then return the gun to us at our great expense. We will at that time gratefully and cheerfully return the money you have sent us. We are absolutely convinced that you will receive a gun from us that is perfect in every respect and so enjoy unloading it 10,000 times that you will spend countless hours alone thinking about the finish, sight, drop, range and penetration that the very idea of this gun ever leaving your side will fill you with worry and dismay. Such is the pleasure of the Lancaster Repeating Shotgun.

We are pleased to offer you direct from the D.D. Packenbush factory an automatic shell ejecting .38 caliber revolver under the promised guarantee that it is superior in every way to any furnished by other revolver makers. Makers have in recent years, in our judgement, been charging too much money for revolvers that often jam and can result in certain death when they are needed most. Percy Hutchins of Valentine wrote us directly to testify, “I was set upon by a bobcat that had holed up in our hay loft, and as it proceeded to wound me my revolver jammed. It tore a gash across my face that left me blind in one eye. If it were not for my brother shooting it dead with his D.D. Packenbush I wouldn't be here to pen this letter of appreciation with my good arm.”

We have received letters from thousands of satisfied purchasers who say that the superior firepower of the Lancaster is satisfactory in every way. In fact, we have not received one piece of correspondence of dissatisfaction, excluding accidental shootings and suicides, which are not the responsibility of the manufacturer.
We have taken into account some of the weaknesses of previous models and strengthened the frame. Thanks to a slide lock, it stays locked until you actually mean to fire it, ensuring that you do not actually shoot a friend or loved one before you intend to. Shells now eject to the side rather than into your face. While there was great debate about this change and many enjoyed the challenge of hunting with hot shells flying towards your eyes, we think the new Lancaster design makes this the finest pump-action shotgun available on the market today.
